post.description: Runs a stored Rule Template with body params bound to its declared :name holes as real binds over its Dataset, returning the matched rows and what each hole was bound to; body limit defaults to 500, max 10000. Persists nothing. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when read-only; 404 for an unknown template or Dataset; 422 for an undeclared hole, a bad parameter, a guard refusal or a failed query.

get.description: A flat view of every Pipeline's Collector acquisition config. No capability gate.

post.summary: Tell a Collector a file has landed
post.description: Fires the Pipeline that owns the Collector now instead of waiting for its poll; the body is ignored. On /api/v1 it answers 202 with the runId and a Location to poll. Gated on canOperateRuns. 404 for an unknown Collector.

get.description: The acquisition counters, gauges and histogram (files discovered and downloaded, failures, bytes, fetch time, stream lag and more) as JSON; also served at the bare unversioned path. No capability gate.

Returns the caller's active notification feed, newest first (query limit, default 50), with read state per reader; addressed, security and in-app-disabled notifications are filtered per caller. No capability gate.
Holds a Server-Sent Events stream open and pushes each new notification the caller may see as a data frame, with a heartbeat comment every 15 seconds. No capability gate.
Returns {count}: active notifications visible to the caller that the caller has not read. No capability gate.

post.summary: Mark all my notifications read
post.description: Marks every active notification read for the caller and returns {updated}, the number that changed. No capability gate (self-service, per reader).

post.summary: Mark a notification read
post.description: Marks one notification read for the caller and returns it as the caller sees it. No capability gate (self-service, per reader). 404 for an unknown notification or one the caller may not see.

post.summary: Mark a notification unread
post.description: Marks one notification unread for the caller and returns it as the caller sees it. No capability gate (self-service, per reader). 404 for an unknown notification or one the caller may not see.

get.summary: The caller’s effective notification preference grid
get.description: Each cell is the calling Subject’s override when it has one, else the deployment default; source marks which (inherited | overridden). Critical categories are always on. email is off and not editable for a Subject with no verified email claim; webhook is never personal. Basic (no Subject): the single grid.

default.description: Envelope-wrapped response (see #/components/schemas/Envelope): data is the grid, one row per category — {category, label, critical, available, channels:{inApp, email, webhook}, source:{channel: inherited | overridden}, editable:{channel: boolean}}.

put.summary: Save the caller’s own preference override (self-service)
put.description: Body {"preferences":[{category, channels:{inApp?, email?}}]}. Writes ONLY the calling Subject’s override, keyed by its stable id; a null cell resets it to the default. Critical categories, webhook, and email-on without a verified email claim are ignored, as is any address in the body — email goes to the Subject’s verified claim only. Basic (no Subject): writes the single grid. 503 when the deployment overrides file exists but is unreadable. Returns the caller’s effective grid.

default.description: Envelope-wrapped response (see #/components/schemas/Envelope): data is the grid, one row per category — {category, label, critical, available, channels:{inApp, email, webhook}, source:{channel: inherited | overridden}, editable:{channel: boolean}}.

get.description: The grid every Subject inherits where it has no override (source is always inherited).

default.description: Envelope-wrapped response (see #/components/schemas/Envelope): data is the grid, one row per category — {category, label, critical, available, channels:{inApp, email, webhook}, source:{channel: inherited | overridden}, editable:{channel: boolean}}.

put.description: Body {"preferences":[{category, channels:{inApp?, email?, webhook?}}]}. Requires canAdminister (403 PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise). Changes the effective grid of every Subject that has not overridden that cell. Critical categories stay locked on. Returns the refreshed default grid.

default.description: Envelope-wrapped response (see #/components/schemas/Envelope): data is the grid, one row per category — {category, label, critical, available, channels:{inApp, email, webhook}, source:{channel: inherited | overridden}, editable:{channel: boolean}}.

get.description: Lists the saved notification channel destinations. No capability gate. Returns an empty list when the write root is unset.

post.summary: Create a notification channel
post.description: Creates a notification channel destination from the body; keys the channel does not model are refused. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 409 when the id exists; 422 for missing fields or an invalid body; 503 when the write root is unset.

put.description: Merges the body over a saved notification channel; the id and createdAt stay as stored. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown channel; 422 for an invalid body; 503 when the write root is unset.

delete.description: Deletes a saved notification channel destination. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown channel; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Lists the operator-authored notification rules. No capability gate. Returns an empty list when the write root is unset.

post.summary: Create a notification rule
post.description: Creates an authored notification rule from the body; keys the rule does not model are refused. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 409 when the id exists; 422 for missing fields or an invalid body; 503 when the write root is unset.

put.description: Replaces an authored notification rule; the id comes from the path. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown notification rule; 422 for an invalid body; 503 when the write root is unset.

delete.description: Deletes an authored notification rule. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown notification rule; 503 when the write root is unset.
Archives one notification for the whole Space, removing it from every user's feed; returns {id, deleted}. Gated on canAdminister. 404 for an unknown notification.

post.summary: Receive a delivery-status callback
post.description: Inbound email-provider callback for the named delivery-status adapter (served under /api/v1): verifies the signature over the raw body, then stamps the matching delivery receipts. No capability gate; the signature is the check. 404 for an unknown or unconfigured adapter; 413 over 512 KiB; 403 for a bad signature; 422 when the payload has no events; 202 when every delivery id is unknown.

200.description: Verified. Either the stamped events, or {"control": kind} for a verified message that carries no delivery events (an SNS SubscriptionConfirmation / UnsubscribeConfirmation), with duplicate:true for a replayed MessageId; no receipt is written for a control message.

413.description: Body over the 512 KiB callback cap (errorCode PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE); never reaches signature verification.

429.description: Per-caller-IP callback budget exhausted (errorCode RATE_LIMITED); providers retry.

get.description: Returns {deliveries}: recent delivery receipts (query limit, default 100) or all for one notification (query notificationId), each with every observed status and its time. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench.

Returns the currently suppressed destinations with their reasons (query limit, default 100, at most 500), the true total, a truncated flag, and whether suppression is armed. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench.

delete.description: Records an override that forgives a destination's delivery history (query target), so it is delivered to again; receipts are kept and a later bounce suppresses it again. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 422 when target is blank; 409 when delivery receipts are not stored durably.

get.description: Returns the Space's branding {logoDataUrl, caption, footerText}; nulls mean the shipped defaults. Carries an ETag and answers 304 for a fresh If-None-Match. No capability gate.

put.description: Replaces the Space's branding with body logoDataUrl, caption and footerText. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 422 when logoDataUrl exceeds 512K characters; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Returns the Space's {tileServerUrl}; null means no self-hosted tile server. Carries an ETag and answers 304 for a fresh If-None-Match. No capability gate.

put.description: Replaces the Space's geo settings with body tileServerUrl. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Returns the Space's processor icon map as {<type>: {glyph, color}}; an empty object when none is set. Carries an ETag and answers 304 for a fresh If-None-Match. No capability gate.

put.summary: Replace the Space's processor icon map
put.description: Replaces the Space's processor icon map with the body, an object of {glyph, color} entries keyed by processor type. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 422 when an entry is not an object or lacks a glyph or color; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Returns the Space's Menu tree {space, version, landing?, nodes}; an empty tree before any save. Carries an ETag and answers 304 for a fresh If-None-Match. No capability gate.

put.description: Replaces the whole Menu tree with body version, nodes and optional landing. Gated on canCurateMenus. 422 for a wrong version or invalid nodes or landing; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Returns the effective role table, authored roles over the shipped seed, each row with capabilities, data scopes and source, plus identity settings and capabilities per product; an unreadable roles document is reported, not hidden. Carries an ETag. No capability gate.

put.description: Fully replaces the authored roles document (body roles, optional identity.attributeClaims and identity.machineClients); seed roles not named keep their defaults. Honours If-Match and may be held for approval (202). Gated on canConfigureAccess. 409 for a stale If-Match; 422 for an invalid roles list or a change that would leave the access policies unloadable; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Returns each capability the role grants, allowed or denied by its Access Profile with the reason, its data scopes and whether an access policy engine is active. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown role.

Returns authored access policies plus the engine's seed policies in force, lint warnings and the resource kinds vocabulary; an unreadable document is reported, its detail only to a caller holding canConfigureAccess. Carries an ETag. No capability gate.

put.description: Fully replaces the authored access policies document (body policies). Honours If-Match and may be held for approval (202). Gated on canConfigureAccess. 409 for a stale If-Match; 422 for an invalid policy or a draft that would deny the caller's own next save; 503 when the write root is unset.

post.summary: Impact matrix for an unsaved Access Policy draft
post.description: Gated canConfigureAccess. Body {policies, route?} is validated exactly like PUT /access/policies (422 on the same checks). Returns {enabled, route, roles, actions, kinds, cells: [{role, action, resourceKind, before, beforePolicy, after, afterPolicy, changed}], warnings: [{policy, code, message}]} — every effective role as a synthetic subject (capabilities + role name, no id or claims) x read/write/operate, plus x each known resource kind a current or draft policy targets. Writes nothing. {enabled:false} without a policy engine (Basic and Standard). A POST, so the route PEP evaluates it as a write against the saved doc.

get.summary: Explain an access decision for my session
get.description: Dry-runs the access policy engine for the caller (query route, method default GET, optional resourceKind) and returns the decision, matched policy and per-policy trace; {enabled:false} without a policy engine or an authenticated subject. No capability gate. 422 when route is missing.
Returns the saved Access Catalog (the tree of menu, pane and action nodes), or an empty version-0 catalog when none is saved. Carries an ETag. No capability gate.

put.description: Replaces the Access Catalog with body version and nodes; each node needs a unique safe id, a label, a kind of menu|pane|action and, for an action, a known capability. Honours If-Match and may be held for approval (202). Gated on canConfigureAccess. 409 for a stale If-Match; 422 for an invalid node tree; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Lists every saved Access Profile, sorted by name. No capability gate. Returns an empty list when the write root is unset.

put.description: Creates or replaces the Access Profile whose id is <subjectType>-<subjectId> (body subjectType lens|role, subjectId, label, grants of nodeId to allow|deny). Honours If-Match and may be held for approval (202). Gated on canConfigureAccess. 409 for a stale If-Match; 422 for an unsafe or mismatched id, a bad subjectType or invalid grants; 503 when the write root is unset.

delete.description: Deletes an Access Profile. May be held for approval (202). Gated on canConfigureAccess. 404 for an unknown Access Profile; 422 for an unsafe id; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Searches AUDIT or ACCESS_DENIED events (query type required; limit, offset, pipeline, correlationId, q, from, to); classified values are masked for a caller who may not unmask them. No capability gate. 400 when type is missing or not one of the auditable types.

Exports AUDIT or ACCESS_DENIED events with the same filters as search; format=csv returns the audit-shaped CSV with one column per audit attribute, otherwise JSON. Classified values are masked as on search. No capability gate. 400 when type is missing or not auditable.
Returns the assist agent's recent failure diagnoses (query limit, default 50). No capability gate. Returns an empty list when the optional agent module is absent.
Returns the server-wide assist model-provider settings as the agent reports them. No capability gate. 503 when the optional agent module is absent.

post.summary: Update the assist model-provider settings
post.description: Saves the server-wide assist model-provider settings (including provider and baseUrl) from the body. Gated on canAdminister. 400 for an invalid setting; 503 when the optional agent module is absent.

get.description: Returns the assist agent's usage metrics. No capability gate. 503 when the optional agent module is absent.

post.summary: Test the assist model-provider settings
post.description: Makes a round-trip call to the saved model provider and returns the result. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when the optional agent module is absent.

post.summary: Ask an assist skill
post.description: Dispatches one request to the assist skill named by the path intent, with body screenContext, partialInput and userText, and returns its result. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown intent; 503 when the agent module is absent or the skill's model is unavailable.

post.summary: Open an intelligence agent session
post.description: Opens a multi-turn agent session (body page, goalKind; role is used only without a signed-in subject, otherwise derived from the caller's capabilities) that carries the caller's capabilities. No capability gate. 400 for an unknown goalKind; 503 when the intelligence module is absent.

post.summary: Ask an agent session a question
post.description: Runs the deliberative loop on body question (with optional page) and returns the agent's answer. No capability gate; only the session's opener may ask. 400 when question is missing; 404 for an unknown session or one another caller opened; 503 when the intelligence module is absent.

post.summary: Ask an agent session (SSE stream)
post.description: Streams the answer to body question as Server-Sent Events: token data frames, an optional artifact frame, then complete or error; an unknown session arrives as an error frame. No capability gate; only the session's opener may ask. 400 when question is missing; 404 for a session another caller opened; 503 when the intelligence module is absent.

post.summary: Run an agent tool from a sentence
post.description: Has the model derive arguments for one non-mutating tool from body prompt (with optional args), runs the tool and returns {value, derivedArgs, turns?}. Gated on the capability the tool declares. 400 when prompt is missing; 404 for an unknown tool; 403 for a mutating tool; 422 when the tool or derivation fails; 503 when the intelligence module or a model is absent.

post.summary: Run one agent tool
post.description: Invokes one non-mutating agent tool with body args and returns its result verbatim; no model is involved. Gated on the capability the tool declares. 404 for an unknown tool; 403 for a mutating tool; 422 when the tool reports a failure; 503 when the intelligence module is absent.

get.description: Returns {triageRuns}: the agent's recent Triage Runs (query limit, default 50). Gated on canRevealLinkEntities. 503 when the intelligence module is absent.

get.summary: Find Triage Runs similar to one
get.description: Returns {similar}: prior Triage Runs like the given one (query k, default 5). Gated on canRevealLinkEntities. 404 for an unknown Triage Run; 503 when the intelligence module is absent.
Returns one Triage Run of the agent. Gated on canRevealLinkEntities. 404 for an unknown Triage Run; 503 when the intelligence module is absent.

post.summary: Rate a Triage Run
post.description: Records operator feedback on a Triage Run (body rating required), attributed to the caller. Gated on canAdminister. 400 when rating is missing or unrecognised; 404 for an unknown Triage Run; 503 when the intelligence module is absent.

get.description: Returns {feedback}: recent operator feedback on Triage Runs (query limit, default 100). Gated on canRevealLinkEntities. 503 when the intelligence module is absent.
Returns {approvals}: the inbox of mutating agent tool calls parked for an operator decision (query limit, default 50). Gated on canRevealLinkEntities. 503 when the intelligence module is absent.
Returns one parked agent approval. Gated on canRevealLinkEntities. 404 for an unknown approval; 503 when the intelligence module is absent.

post.summary: Approve or decline an agent action
post.description: Decides a parked agent tool call (body decision approve|decline, optional decidedBy): approve resumes it, decline denies it. Gated on canAdminister. 400 for a missing or unrecognised decision; 404 for an unknown or already-decided approval; 503 when the intelligence module is absent.

get.description: Returns the bounded-autonomy policy: kill switch and per-action-class mode and budget. No capability gate. 503 when the intelligence module or its autonomy tier is absent.

put.description: Updates the bounded-autonomy policy from the body, attributed to the caller. Gated on canAdminister. 503 when the intelligence module or its autonomy tier is absent.

post.summary: Engage or release the autonomy kill switch
post.description: Sets the autonomy kill switch from body engaged (a boolean or yes/no style word). Gated on canAdminister. 400 when engaged is missing or unrecognised; 503 when the intelligence module or its autonomy tier is absent.

get.description: Returns {actions}: the autonomy ledger of what the monitoring loop did, why and its spend (query limit, default 50). No capability gate. 503 when the intelligence module is absent.
Returns one entry of the autonomy ledger. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown action; 503 when the intelligence module is absent.
Reports what operational database this deployment actually uses, per store family; no password is returned. Carries an ETag. Gated on canConfigureAccess.

post.summary: Test an operational database URL
post.description: Opens a proposed JDBC URL for real and runs SELECT 1 (body url, user, password as a secret reference); nothing is stored. Gated on canConfigureAccess. 422 for a missing url, a scheme it will not dial, a URL the server egress gate refuses, or a literal password.

get.description: Returns the answering Pod's server-wide Consignment cap, intake thresholds, DuckDB memory limit, Job Run bound and named pools, each with its provenance, plus the bound Space's tier, host cores and live occupancy with throttled Pipelines. Carries an ETag. No capability gate.

put.description: Merges the body into the server-wide scheduler document per key (absent keeps, null clears) and hot-applies it on the answering Pod: maxConcurrentConsignments, intake fields, duckdbMemoryLimit, maxConcurrentJobRuns, pools. Gated on canOperateRuns. 422 for an out-of-range or malformed value; 503 when no writable Space is bound or no document home exists.

Sets or clears (null) install-layer Link Analysis limits from a body of {<key>: number|null} on the answering Pod and rebuilds the rate limits. Gated on canAdminister. 422 for an unknown key, a Space-layer key or a value out of range; 409 when the stored document does not parse; 503 when no writable Space is bound or no server-wide document home exists.

get.description: Returns the bound Space's Consignment cap with its provenance, its stored poll and acquire cadences, and the cadences in force on its running timers. Carries an ETag. No capability gate.

put.description: Merges body maxConcurrentConsignments (0..100000), pollSeconds and acquirePollSeconds (1..86400) into the Space's scheduler document per key (absent keeps, null clears) and hot-applies them. Gated on canOperateRuns. 422 for an out-of-range or non-integer value; 503 when no writable Space is bound.

get.description: Generated from the live route table by OpenApiPathsContractTest; request and response schemas are not yet documented — see control-api.md §5 for the exemplar-coverage decision.

post.summary: Project a Dataset onto map points
post.description: Returns one map point per row with valid coordinates (body dataset, latCol, lonCol, optional entityCol, entityIdCol, kindCol, timeCol, attrCols, limit), plus truncated and the count of skipped rows. No capability gate. 422 when dataset or a coordinate column is missing or a column is not a safe identifier; 404 for an unknown or not-viewable Dataset; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Project a Dataset onto map routes
post.description: Folds origin-to-destination rows into points and routes deduplicated per (origin, destination, kind) with a summed weight (body dataset, fromLatCol, fromLonCol, toLatCol, toLonCol, optional fromCol, toCol, kindCol, limit). No capability gate. 422 when dataset or a coordinate column is missing or a column is not a safe identifier; 404 for an unknown or not-viewable Dataset; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Fold a Dataset into distinct links (compact edge rows)
post.description: PERF-P10-1 (2026-11-12): answered as application/vnd.inspecto.la-edges.v2+json - column names once and each folded link as an array; this REPLACED the per-row object shape (no compatibility shape is served). ETag / If-None-Match revalidation answers 304 with no body. An error is plain application/json. A Dataset the caller may not view is 404 (R3).

ETag / If-None-Match revalidation answers 304 with no body. An error is plain application/json. A Dataset the caller may not view is 404 (R3). post.summary: Project entities across several Datasets
post.description: Runs node mappings and edge projections over several Datasets in one call (body nodes, edges, optional filter, limit per mapping) and returns their union, each node and edge tagged with its provenance Dataset. No capability gate. 422 when neither nodes nor edges is given, there are too many mappings or an identifier or filter is invalid; 404 for an unknown or not-viewable Dataset; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Simple paths from a start node, walked server-side (from the edge index when it can answer exactly)
post.description: LA-11 / D-3 step 5. Body {dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, startNode, targetNode?, maxDepth?, direction?, weightCol?, temporalConstraint?, filter?, maxEdgeYield?, limit?}. Answers {paths:[{nodes,hops,weight}], truncated, edgeYieldCapped, fences, source}. `source` says where the answer came from: {kind:'index', version, stale, staleReason?, fingerprint} when it was read from the Dataset's edge index (on unless the Space sets index.enabled: false; needs a published index for exactly the request's columns, maxDepth <= 2 and at most 20 distinct frontier keys per level); otherwise {kind:'dataset', reason, details?} with reason one of index_disabled, no_index, mapping_not_indexed, column_not_indexed, time_zone_not_servable, filter_not_indexed, index_stale_refused, depth_over_index_cap, frontier_over_index_cap, index_read_failed - the unchanged flat read answered. A frontier found over the cap mid-walk discards the partial index answer and re-answers whole from the flat Dataset. The base-Dataset view gate runs first (a Dataset the caller cannot view is the same 404 whether or not an index exists).

200.description: Envelope data {paths, truncated, edgeYieldCapped, fences, source}.

stale.description: kind=index: the index is served but flagged (e.g. built with another DuckDB version).

staleReason.description: kind=index: why it is out of date, in plain words, e.g. '2 files were added to the Dataset after the index was built' (the index misses the new rows).

fingerprint.description: kind=index: unknown = the Dataset's input files cannot be listed (view-backed, too many files), so currency is not knowable.

details.description: kind=dataset with reason index_stale_refused: what changed (removed or replaced input file, relation SQL, bucket function).

reason.description: kind=dataset: why the flat Dataset answered.

403.description: A sensitive read above the Space's four-eyes thresholds (the same refusal on either path).

404.description: Unknown Dataset, or one the caller may not view.

422.description: A malformed field or an unknown column.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

get.description: Infers entity-projection mappings by naming convention: each <base>_id column is linked to the Dataset named <base> on its id column (high confidence) or a same-named column (medium); Datasets that cannot be probed are skipped and counted. No capability gate. 503 when the control plane is read-only.

Returns the cross-Space shareable catalog (metadata only, never rows) with each offer's snapshot freshness and last refresh outcome; optional query owner narrows to one Space. No capability gate. 409 in single-tenant mode, where cross-Space sharing is not available.

post.summary: Offer a Dataset, Widget or saved View on the Exchange
post.description: Lists or updates an offer of a component in the owner Space (body kind dataset|widget|view, owner, item, optional description, resultSet, refresh); a Widget or saved View needs its Datasets offered first. Gated on canOfferDatasets in the owner Space. 400 for a bad kind, item or owner, or a signal kind; 404 for an unknown Space or component; 409 in single-tenant mode or when a bound Dataset is not offered; 422 for an invalid refresh or an unshareable component.

post.summary: Offer a Signal type on the Exchange
post.description: The owner Space announces a dotted Signal type (body owner, item, optional description, payloadKeys allowlist) that another Space may request to receive. Gated on canOfferSignals in the owner Space. 400 for an invalid owner, Signal type or payload key; 403 when the owner Space is not hosted; 422 for a delivered exchange.* Signal type; 409 in single-tenant mode.

post.summary: Refresh an offered Dataset's snapshot
post.description: Publishes a fresh Exchange snapshot of an offered Dataset from the owner Space's current data (body owner, item) and returns the snapshot metadata. Gated on canOfferDatasets in the owner Space. 400 for an invalid owner or item; 404 for an unknown Space or a Dataset that is not offered; 409 in single-tenant mode or when the Space has no registry; 422 when the snapshot is refused as invalid.

post.summary: Request a share from another Space
post.description: A consumer Space requests use of an offered item (body kind, owner, consumer, item, optional purpose, mode) and receives the requested grant. Gated on canRequestShares in the consumer Space. 400 for a bad kind, item or Space id, or a Space requesting from itself; 404 for an unknown Space or no such offer; 409 in single-tenant mode or for a conflicting grant; 422 for an invalid mode.

post.summary: Approve, deny or revoke an Exchange grant
post.description: The owner Space acts on a share grant; action is approve, deny or revoke. Approving a snapshot-mode Dataset share also publishes its first snapshot and reports the outcome under snapshots. Gated on canApproveShares in the grant's owner Space. 404 for an unknown grant; 409 in single-tenant mode or when the grant's state does not allow the action.

post.summary: Pin an Exchange grant to a snapshot version
post.description: The consumer Space sets or clears (body version) the snapshot version its grant resolves to. Gated on canRequestShares in the grant's consumer Space. 404 for an unknown grant; 409 in single-tenant mode.

post.summary: Set an Exchange grant's expiry
post.description: The owner Space sets or clears a grant's expiry; body expiresAt is epoch millis, null or absent clears it. Gated on canApproveShares in the grant's owner Space. 400 when expiresAt is not epoch millis; 404 for an unknown grant; 409 in single-tenant mode.

get.description: Returns the share-grant ledger; optional query space narrows it to grants shared by or with that Space. No capability gate. 409 in single-tenant mode.

Returns the offer for the Dataset named by the path's owner Space and item, with snapshot freshness; with query consumer it also carries that consumer's grant. No capability gate. 404 when the Dataset is not offered; 409 in single-tenant mode.

get.summary: Render-only view of a shared Widget
get.description: Returns the Widget's config (path names the owner Space and Widget) read-only, with the shared Dataset ref the consumer binds through. No capability gate; the consumer's grants decide. 400 when query consumer is missing; 403 without an active grant on the Widget and its Dataset; 404 for an unknown Space or Widget; 409 in single-tenant mode.

get.summary: Render-only view of a shared saved View
get.description: Returns the saved View's config (path names the owner Space and View) read-only, its Dataset mappings rewritten to the consumer's shared refs. No capability gate; the consumer's grants decide. 400 when query consumer is missing; 403 without an active grant on the View and every Dataset it reads; 404 for an unknown Space or View; 409 in single-tenant mode.
Returns the global metric registry in Prometheus text exposition format (version 0.0.4). No capability gate.

Returns the newest events from the live-tail ring (query limit, default 50); on /api/v1 it is instead a cursor-paginated page (limit up to 500, cursor) of the full retained history, newest first. Audit rows are masked for a caller without the unmask capability. No capability gate.
Returns events matching the query filters level, type, pipeline, correlationId, q, from, to, limit and offset; for a masked caller q and correlationId match the masked event. No capability gate.
Exports the events matching the search filters as JSON, or as CSV with query format=csv; a CSV filtered to type AUDIT or ACCESS_DENIED adds one column per audit attribute. No capability gate.
Returns the server-wide saved event filter views. No capability gate.

post.summary: Save an event view
post.description: Creates or replaces a server-wide saved filter view from body name and optional level, type, pipeline, correlationId, q, from, to. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 400 when name is missing; 422 for any other unmodelled body key.

post.summary: Delete a saved event view
post.description: Deletes the server-wide saved event view with the given name. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 when no saved view has that name.

get.description: Scans the newest retained events for an exact event id and returns it, masked for a caller without the unmask capability. No capability gate. 404 when no recent event has that id.

Lists Alerts, Incidents, Cases and Tasks the caller may see, filtered by query type, status, severity, assignee, owner, correlationId, q, limit and offset (on /api/v1, cursor-paginated newest first), masked for a caller who cannot reveal keys. No capability gate. 400 for an unknown type; 503 when operational objects are not available.

post.summary: Open an Incident or other operational object
post.description: Creates an operational object (body title required, type default INCIDENT, optional description, severity, priority, owner, assignee, correlationId, attributes, dueAt or dueInMinutes) linked to at least one existing object named in links. Gated on canManageIncidents. 400 when title or links is missing or type is unknown; 404 for a link target that is absent or out of scope; 422 for an attribute owned by a dedicated route (impact, disposition).

get.description: Returns the analytics roll-up of operational objects, optionally for one object kind (query type). No capability gate. 400 for an unknown type; 503 when operational objects are not available.

The Incidents and Cases that reference an Entity (e.g. an MSISDN), newest first, under the same SEC-7d/ABAC visibility as GET /objects. Each item: {kind: incident|case, id, title, status, severity?, createdAt, matchedOn: key.<column>|entityKey|member, via? (the member Incident, for matchedOn=member)}. 422 on an unknown type, a missing/oversized id, a bad status or limit.

post.summary: Acknowledge an operational object
post.description: Applies the ack lifecycle action; the actor is the signed-in Subject, else body actor. Gated on canWorkIncidents. 404 for an unknown or out-of-scope object; 422 when the workflow does not allow the move; 409 for an inert object or a lost concurrent update.

post.summary: Resolve an Incident, Alert or Case
post.description: The fixed `resolve` action (WS-10). An Incident resolves only with a `disposition` from the Disposition ladder — absent or unknown is 422, as is any other gap of the resolution gate (timeline, cause analysis, corrective actions, SLA). A `disposition` on a non-Incident is 422: a Case records its Disposition in its Findings. Reopening an Incident clears the recorded disposition, so the next resolve must decide again.

actor.description: Who made the move; defaults to the signed-in principal.

200.description: The object after the move (its attribute bag carries the recorded disposition).

post.summary: Move an object through its Workflow
post.description: Body `{action}` (a Workflow action, e.g. `accept`, `resolve`, `archive`, `reopen`) or `{status}` / `{to}` (a target state); one of them is required (else 400). `disposition` rides only a move that DECIDES an Incident — `RESOLVED`, or any terminal state of its Workflow except `ARCHIVED` — where it is REQUIRED (a value of the Disposition ladder, else 422); on any other move it is 422. Moving an Incident out of RESOLVED/ARCHIVED back to a working state (reopen) clears the recorded disposition.

action.description: A Workflow action of the object's type.

status.description: A target state, instead of an action.

actor.description: Who made the move; defaults to the signed-in principal.

200.description: The object after the move (its attribute bag carries the recorded disposition).

post.summary: Assign an operational object
post.description: Assigns the object to body assignee; the actor is the signed-in Subject, else body actor. Gated on canWorkIncidents. 400 when assignee is missing or invalid; 404 for an unknown or out-of-scope object; 422 when the object's state refuses it; 409 for an inert object or a lost concurrent update.

post.summary: Link two operational objects
post.description: Correlates this object with another (body to, optional relationship such as CONTAINS, actor); a duplicate edge returns the existing one. No capability gate. 400 when to is missing; 404 for an unknown or out-of-scope object or target; 409 for an inert object.

get.summary: Correlation links of an operational object
get.description: Returns the object's correlation links. No capability gate. 404 when the object is out of the caller's data scope; 503 when operational objects are not available.

delete.summary: Remove a link between operational objects
delete.description: Removes one correlation edge named by query to and optional relationship (for example a member Incident leaving a Case); the removal is audited. No capability gate. 400 when to is missing; 404 for an unknown or out-of-scope object or an absent link; 409 for an inert object.

post.summary: Merge Cases into this Case
post.description: Absorbs the body sources Cases into this surviving Case: members re-point, tags and watchers union, and the sources close with a merged-into trace. Gated on canAdminister. 400 when sources is empty; 404 for an unknown or out-of-scope Case; 422 for a non-Case, a self-merge or a source already closed or merged; 409 for an inert object.

post.summary: Split members out of a Case
post.description: Carves the listed member Incidents (body members, title, optional assignee, actor) out of this Case into a new Case. Gated on canAdminister. 400 when title or members is missing; 404 for an unknown or out-of-scope Case or member; 422 for a non-Case, a closed Case or a member it does not contain; 409 for an inert object.

get.summary: Correlation graph around an operational object
get.description: Returns the correlation subgraph around the object (query depth, default 2, at most 5), pruning nodes and edges outside the caller's data scope. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown or out-of-scope object.

post.summary: Comment on an operational object
post.description: Adds a comment (body body); the author is the signed-in Subject, else body author. No capability gate. 400 when body is missing; 404 for an unknown or out-of-scope object; 409 for an inert object.

get.description: Returns the object's comments, masked for a caller who cannot reveal keys. No capability gate. 404 when the object is out of the caller's data scope; 503 when operational objects are not available.

post.summary: Attach evidence to an operational object
post.description: Records an evidence reference, metadata only (body name, uri, optional contentType, author, caption). No capability gate. 400 when name or uri is missing; 404 for an unknown or out-of-scope object; 409 for an inert object.

get.description: Returns the object's evidence attachments (metadata only), masked for a caller who cannot reveal keys. No capability gate. 404 when the object is out of the caller's data scope; 503 when operational objects are not available.

post.summary: Seed an RCA skeleton on an operational object
post.description: Adds one comment per section of an RCA template: body template names a loaded template, or carries an inline {name, sections}, or the body itself is the template. No capability gate. 400 for an invalid inline template; 404 for an unknown named template or an unknown or out-of-scope object; 409 for an inert object.

put.summary: Save a Case's Findings values (collaboration; open to anyone who can see the object)
put.description: Stores the canonical attributes.findings blob plus the flat recordsAffected copy (derived server-side; a Case's money is its typed impact, PUT /objects/{id}/impact), validated against the effective findings-spec (422). The body may carry ONLY 'findings' — any other key is refused 422, so disposition stays on the canAdminister PATCH /objects/{id}. Missing 'findings' → 400; out-of-scope or unknown id → 404. Audited as an OBJECT_ACTIVITY 'findings' event with the request's actor.

findings.description: Findings values by section key; each a scalar

default.description: Envelope-wrapped response (see #/components/schemas/Envelope); data is the updated object.

get.description: Returns the object, masked for a caller who cannot reveal keys. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown or out-of-scope object; 503 when operational objects are not available.

patch.summary: Edit an object's operator-mutable fields (priority, severity, assignee, attributes)
patch.description: Gated canAdminister (disposition is administrative, operator decision 2026-09-15). Findings values have their own collaboration route, PUT /objects/{objectId}/findings. Optional body `version` (the integer a GET returned): if the stored object has moved on, 409 CONFLICT_STALE_VERSION and nothing is written; absent keeps last-write-wins; a non-integer is 400. On a build without inspecto-ops the core stub answers 503 not-installed.

default.description: Envelope-wrapped response (see #/components/schemas/Envelope); data is the updated object.

get.description: Returns the RCA templates loaded from *_rca.toon files. No capability gate.

get.summary: Effective workflow of an object kind
get.description: Returns the effective lifecycle definition (built-in or overridden) for an operational object kind such as INCIDENT or CASE, so the UI can derive folders and action verbs. No capability gate. 400 for an unknown kind; 503 when operational objects are not available.

get.summary: Effective Findings sections of an object kind
get.description: Returns the authored findings-spec for an operational object kind, or case.<caseType> for one Case type falling back to the generic Case spec, else the built-in default. No capability gate. 400 for an unknown kind.

post.summary: Open a Case whose first members are minted from Link Analysis Entities
post.description: LA-CASE-CREATE-IN-PLACE-1. Each {id, dataset} entry is a Link Analysis Entity (node id entity:[<type>:]<normalised key>, D-S4) and is minted as an INCIDENT keyed by entityKey + entityDataset, or REUSED when that identity already exists and is visible to the caller; an {objectId} entry names an existing Incident. The Case CONTAINS every member. Gated on canManageIncidents (403). Missing title or no entities 400; a malformed entity, an entity whose key is a masked pseudonym (masked:<hex>, refused for every caller), an entity of a classified Dataset for a caller without canRevealLinkEntities (value-free, identical whether or not an Incident exists), a non-INCIDENT objectId or more than 100 entities 422; an absent or out-of-scope objectId 404. Everything is checked before the first write, and a failed write rolls back every object the call created.

dataset.description: The Dataset the Entity was projected from

label.description: Title of a minted Incident (the raw spelling)

objectId.description: An existing Incident instead of an Entity

get.description: Returns the registered Case Rules that auto-group Incidents into a Case. No capability gate. 503 when operational objects are not available.

post.summary: Save a Case Rule
post.description: Creates or replaces a Case Rule (body name, title, filter with at least one criterion, optional threshold, windowMinutes, category, tags), persisted as <name>_caserule.toon under the write root. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 422 for an invalid or unmodelled body or an unsafe name; 403 when the file path escapes the write root; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

delete.description: Removes the Case Rule from the registry and deletes its persisted file. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown Case Rule; 422 for an unsafe name; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Evaluate a Case Rule
post.description: Groups the Incidents matching the Case Rule into a Case and returns matched, grouped, caseId and opened. Gated on canAdminister. 404 for an unknown Case Rule.

get.description: Returns the comments and attachments on one target, newest first; the path names the target kind (object, or a component type such as link-analysis-view) and the target id. No capability gate; the caller must be able to see the target. 400 for an unknown target kind; 404 for an absent or not-visible target.

Returns the comments on one target, newest first; the path names the target kind (object or a component type) and the target id. An object's notes are masked for a caller who cannot reveal keys. No capability gate; the caller must be able to see the target. 400 for an unknown target kind; 404 for an absent or not-visible target.

post.summary: Comment on a target
post.description: Adds a comment (body body) to the target named by the path's kind and id; the author is the signed-in Subject, else body author. No capability gate; the caller must be able to see the target. 400 when body is missing or the target kind is unknown; 404 for an absent or not-visible target.

get.description: Returns the evidence attachments on one target, newest first; the path names the target kind (object or a component type) and the target id. No capability gate; the caller must be able to see the target. 400 for an unknown target kind; 404 for an absent or not-visible target.

post.summary: Attach evidence to a target
post.description: Records an evidence reference, metadata only (body name, uri, optional contentType, author, caption), on the target named by the path's kind and id. No capability gate; the caller must be able to see the target. 400 when name or uri is missing or the target kind is unknown; 404 for an absent or not-visible target.

get.description: Returns the tag registry, first adopting tags that exist only inside a Widget's own config. No capability gate. 503 when operational objects are not available.

post.summary: Create a tag
post.description: Registers a tag (body name) and persists it as <name>_tag.toon under the write root. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 409 when the tag already exists; 422 for an invalid, unsafe or unmodelled body; 403 when the file path escapes the write root; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Rename a tag everywhere
post.description: Renames a tag (body to) across the registry, every assignment, each affected object's and Widget's tags and any Tag Rule that applies it; renaming onto an existing tag merges the two. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 400 when to is missing; 404 for an unknown tag; 422 for an invalid or unsafe name; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.description: Returns the Tag Rules, saved searches that auto-tag new operational objects. No capability gate. 503 when operational objects are not available.

post.summary: Save a Tag Rule
post.description: Creates or replaces a Tag Rule (body name, tag, filter with at least one of type, q, status, priority, severity, category), persisted as <name>_tagrule.toon; saving registers the Tag Rule's tag. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 422 for an invalid or unmodelled body, an unknown filter key or an unsafe name; 403 when the file path escapes the write root; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

delete.description: Removes the Tag Rule from the registry and deletes its persisted file. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown Tag Rule; 422 for an unsafe name; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Apply a Tag Rule to existing objects
post.description: Bulk-applies the Tag Rule to every existing matching operational object (idempotent) and returns matched and updated. No capability gate. 404 for an unknown Tag Rule.

get.description: Returns the tag's assignments across target kinds, filtered to the targets the caller may see, so counts can differ between callers. No capability gate.

Returns the tags on the target named by the path's target kind and target id, alphabetical. No capability gate; the caller must be able to see the target. 404 for an absent or not-visible target; 400 for an unknown target kind.

post.summary: Apply a tag to a target
post.description: Applies an existing tag (body tag, optional actor) to the target named by the path's target kind and id, idempotently, and returns the stored assignment. No capability gate; the caller must be able to see the target. 400 when tag is missing; 404 for an absent or not-visible target or an unregistered tag.

delete.summary: Remove a tag from a target
delete.description: Removes one tag (last path segment) from the target named by the path's target kind and id, idempotently, and reports whether it was removed. No capability gate; the caller must be able to see the target. 404 for an absent or not-visible target; 400 for an unknown target kind.

Retires a tag: its registry entry, its file and every assignment, re-projecting each affected object and Widget. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 404 for an unknown tag; 409 while a Tag Rule still applies it; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Raw rows behind one Reconciliation key
post.description: Returns the raw rows on both compared sides for one key of a saved Reconciliation (id) or an inline config; body key must name every key column, with optional side (b or c), day and limit. No capability gate. 422 when key is missing, side is not b|c or the config or comparison fails; 404 for an unknown Reconciliation or Dataset; 503 when the control plane is read-only or the query sandbox cannot be opened.

day.description: The ONE day to compare (yyyy-mm-dd) of each Dataset's temporal column (columns[].role temporal, else dateField); absent = the latest day present on any side. A Dataset with no temporal column is a 422 (RECON-PERF-1, operator 2026-10-09).

get.description: Returns {count}: enabled Expectations whose persisted lastResult status is FAILED, without evaluating anything. No capability gate. Returns 0 when the write root is unset.

{count, datasets, capped} for ?type= (comma-separated, each exact or a prefix.* glob) between ?since= and ?until=; datasets counts distinct payload.dataset values once, and capped marks a lower bound when the ledger page was full. No capability gate. 422 without type; 400 for a non-numeric time bound.
Compares the Run in the path with a second Run (last segment) by kind, from their recorded facts and Run Artifacts. No capability gate. 404 when either Run is unknown or no Jobs are registered.

get.summary: The route inventory this server registered
get.description: Every registered route with the posture it declared: a capability, or an exemption with its category and reason. Reports what this server actually DEPLOYED (including optional modules a source scan cannot see), plus counts by posture and a digest over the sorted table — the same digest the route.inventory.snapshot audit event records once per boot, so a running server can be tied to the event that announced its shape. A read, therefore open by policy: it exposes the shape of the surface, never data behind it. Route-gating compliance plan step 4d; evidence in compliance/evidence/route-gating.md.
Returns the fixed list of assist skills {id, name, description}: explain-entity, diagnose-break, draft-pipeline and triage-alert. No capability gate.

get.summary: The Analytics function catalogue: every function the Analytics Kernel offers
get.description: Answers {total, kernels[{id, label, count}], functions[{id, label, kernel, cost, result, forms[], step, summary, params[{name, type, default, min, max, choices, description}]}]}. cost is a hint (constant, linear, linearithmic, quadratic); result is the kind of value returned; step names the pipeline Step id when the function is also one. Optional ?kernel=statistics|profiler|time_series|forecast|similarity|grouping|graph|cohort|model narrows the list (counts stay whole); any other value is 422 naming the valid ones. Read-only and ungated: it describes functions and runs none. Functions come from registered AnalyticsFunctionProviders, so later kernels appear without a change here.

Returns the Space's Link Analysis settings (node caps, masking mode, four-eyes thresholds, entity types, graphRun, index, drafts and embed blocks) with read-only InForce echoes; nulls inherit the shipped defaults. Carries an ETag. No capability gate.

put.summary: Replace the Space's Link Analysis settings
put.description: Replaces the Space's Link Analysis settings; a numeric limit key the body leaves out keeps its stored value (limits are edited at /settings/link-analysis/limits) and a stated null clears it. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 422 for an out-of-range or non-integer cap, an unknown masking mode or invalid entity types; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.description: Returns every Link Analysis limit as {key, layer, browser, group, unit, default, min, max, value, inForce, editable, description}, ordered by group; editable says whether this caller may change it. Install values are the answering Pod's. Carries an ETag. No capability gate.

put.summary: Set the Space's Link Analysis limits
put.description: Sets or clears (null) Space-layer Link Analysis limits from a body of {<key>: number|null}; nothing is written unless every key passes. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 422 for an unknown key, an install-layer key, a value out of range or an inconsistent drafts or embed pair; 409 when the stored document does not parse; 503 when no writable Space is bound.

get.summary: The Space's Domain Profile: the active Industry pack's terminology and the installed packs
get.description: Answers {active, stated, extraPacks[], profile, installed[], refused[]}. active is the pack id in force, or generic (the neutral vocabulary) when none is stated or the stated one is not installed (then diagnostic says so). profile is the active pack in full: terms keyed by canonical concept key, the profile hints, the relabelled Entity Types and the link kinds. extraPacks are the further installed packs whose Entity Types join the Domain Profile's, merged by id (ENTITY-TYPE-CATALOG-1). A pack that failed validation at load, or does not read together with the packs installed before it, is listed under refused, never installed.

put.description: Body {domainProfile: pack id | generic | null, extraPacks?: [pack id]}. extraPacks left out keeps the stored ones, [] clears them. 503 without a writable Space; 422 when domainProfile is missing, not a string or null, or not an installed Industry pack, or when extraPacks is not a list of installed pack ids, or the chosen packs do not read together (one Entity Type id stated differently); 409 when link-analysis.toon does not parse (left as it is). Writes only domain_profile and extra_packs and answers the GET shape.

get.summary: Read the Space's Pipeline config-history retention
get.description: Returns {keep, effectiveKeep, defaultKeep, maxKeep}: the config versions kept per Pipeline (PIPELINE-CONFIG-HISTORY-1). keep null = the shipped default (50), a default the operator can change.

put.summary: Set the Space's Pipeline config-history retention
put.description: Body {keep}: an integer 1..1000, or null for the shipped default; anything else is 422, never clamped. Stored as pipeline-history.toon in the Space's config root; a lower value prunes on each Pipeline's next save. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench; 503 when writes are disabled.

get.description: Returns {rows, effectiveRows, defaultRows, maxRows}: the most rows a Dashboard Widget reads from a Dataset when it asks for no number itself (POST /bi/query and the public share read). rows null = the shipped default (1,000).

put.description: Body {rows}: an integer 1..10000, or null for the shipped default; anything else is 422, never clamped. Stored as list-limit.toon in the Space's config root. A request's own limit still wins. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench; 503 when writes are disabled.

get.description: Returns {timezone, effectiveTimezone}: the IANA zone a KPI without its own timezone is evaluated in. timezone null = UTC.

put.description: Body {timezone}: an IANA region zone name (e.g. Asia/Kolkata), or null/blank for UTC; an unknown name or an offset form is 422. Stored as timezone.toon in the Space's config root. A KPI's own timezone always wins. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench; 503 when writes are disabled.

post.summary: Profile value overlap between Dataset columns
post.description: Estimates the distinct-value overlap of column pairs across different Datasets (body optional datasets, columns, limit on pairs measured) and reports pairsConsidered and truncated. No capability gate. 404 for a named Dataset that is unknown or not viewable; 422 for a column that no profiled Dataset has or an unsafe name; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Seal a Link Analysis evidence snapshot
post.description: Stores the graph snapshot body as given (id, manifestHash, nodes, edges and the rest); a sealed snapshot is never replaced. Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 for a missing or unsafe id or a missing manifestHash; 403 when the id escapes the snapshot directory; 409 when the id already exists; 500 when the body cannot be serialised; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.description: Returns sealed evidence snapshot ids, newest first, with the true total and a truncated flag; query limit defaults to and is clamped by the Space's snapshot page limits. No capability gate. 422 when limit is not an integer; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Attach a sealed snapshot to a Case
post.description: Records that a sealed snapshot (body snapshotId) is attached to a Case (body caseId) in a separate log, never reopening the snapshot; returns the snapshot's attachments. Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 for a bad snapshotId or a missing caseId; 404 for an unknown snapshot or a Case the caller cannot see; 503 when the control plane is read-only or Case management is not installed.

post.summary: Create an Investigation
post.description: Creates an Investigation over a Dataset (body purpose, dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, optional id, title, linkKindCol, timeCol, timeColZone, eventsCol, caseRef); the Space's auto-applied category lists become its first steps. Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 for a missing or unsafe field or a column the Dataset lacks; 404 for an unknown or not-viewable Dataset; 409 when the id is taken; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.description: The Investigations the caller may read, newest first, paged by limit and offset. Answers {items, total, offset, limit, truncated}; each item {id, title, dataset, owner, ownerName?, createdAt, headStep, caseRef?, access, readOnly}, the title masked per the Space's maskingMode. ownerName (T-186, additive) is the owner's display name as recorded when the Investigation was created, forked or instantiated, masked as the title; an older Investigation without one names only the caller's own (from the signed-in Subject) and is absent otherwise, so a client shows the owner login id.

post.summary: Append a step to an Investigation
post.description: Appends one op from the closed vocabulary (seed, expand, exclude, hide, keep, window, annotate and others; body op plus its params) to the main log, sealing what it read. Gated on canManageIncidents, and the caller must be a lead. 422 when op is missing, outside the vocabulary or its params are invalid; 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 403 for a member who is not a lead; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Undo the latest Investigation step
post.description: Revert the newest effective step of the main log (a recorded undo entry). Optional body {undoes: step} names the step the caller means to revert (LA-GROW-EXCLUDE-UNDO-RACE-1): when another step is the newest by now - a team member's - the answer is 409 CONFLICT_STALE_VERSION naming it and nothing is written; undoes not a whole number from 1 is 422. Without a body the newest step is undone. 409 CONFLICT when there is nothing to undo. Gated on canManageIncidents, and the caller must be a lead: 403 for another member.

undoes.description: The step the caller means to undo; 409 when it is not the newest effective step.

post.summary: Fork an Investigation with its steps reordered
post.description: Creates a new Investigation whose header names this one as parent, re-applying the effective op steps in the body order (a permutation of them) and re-reading every expand; optional id and title. Gated on canManageIncidents, and the caller must be a lead. 422 when order is missing or not a permutation of the effective steps; 409 when the fork id is taken; 404 when absent or not readable; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Replay an Investigation's sealed log
post.description: Re-evaluates the sealed log (to body at when given) and reports whether every step's Working Set hash still matches; with body reread, re-runs each effective expand's recorded query and reports drift. Persists nothing. No capability gate; any member may call it. 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 422 for an unsafe id; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.description: Returns the Investigation's log entries, bounded by query limit, with the true total. No capability gate; any member, or a member of a linked Case, may read it. 422 for a bad limit or unsafe id; 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Reveal the masked entities on screen, with a reason, audited per entity
post.description: Body {tokens: [1..input.reveal_ids masked ids], reason (1..200 chars)} -> {id, revealed:[{token, id}], unknown, reason, masking}. A token this Investigation never issued is listed under unknown, never guessed. One LINK_ENTITY_REVEALED audit row per entity revealed, with the token and the reason, never the raw id; later responses stay masked. Gates: 403 without canRevealLinkEntities, 403 a member who is not a lead, 404 anyone else, 422 a missing or over-long token list or a missing, blank or over-200-character reason.

post.summary: Approve a pending four-eyes request
post.description: A second person approves a held sensitive expand or Draft promote, which then runs as the requester's step, sealed with the approval. Gated on canApproveLinkExpansions; a lead or reviewer where there are members. 403 without an authenticated Subject or when the requester decides their own request; 404 for an unknown request or Investigation; 409 when already decided or nothing is left to expand; 422 for an unsafe request id or a reason over 200 characters.

post.summary: Deny a pending four-eyes request
post.description: A second person denies a held sensitive expand, recording who denied it and an optional body reason; nothing is read. Gated on canApproveLinkExpansions; a lead or reviewer where the Investigation has members. 403 without an authenticated Subject or when the requester decides their own request; 404 for an unknown request or Investigation; 409 when already decided; 422 for an unsafe request id or a reason over 200 characters.

get.description: The held Link Analysis requests (sensitive expands, promotes of a Draft carrying one) across the Space's Investigations that the CALLER may decide: each Investigation is judged by the same gate approve/deny open through (membership role, R3, Advanced PDP), and the caller's own requests are never listed. Gates: canApproveLinkExpansions 403 → write root 503 → no authenticated Subject 403 → bad status/limit 422. Entity ids, titles and purposes are masked per the Space's maskingMode. Audited as LINK_EXPANSION_INBOX_READ. data: {items[{investigationId, title, dataset, purpose, requestId, kind, status, requestedBy, requestedAt, params, sensitivity, summary, draftId?, decidedBy?, decidedAt?, reason?}], total, limit, truncated, status}.

Builds the Investigation's Dossier from its sealed log (query at, snapshots, format json|steps|method|html), masked per the Space's masking mode; steps and method answer plain text, html one printable page. No capability gate; any member or linked-Case member may read it. 422 for a bad at, format, unsafe id or an unanchored snapshot; 404 when the Investigation or a snapshot is absent or not readable; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Verify a Dossier manifest
post.description: Rebuilds the Dossier manifest from the store as it is now for the submitted position and snapshots (body manifest, or a whole Dossier) and names every artefact that changed, went missing or appeared. Persists nothing. No capability gate. 422 when the body is not a manifest for this Investigation or names too many snapshots; 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.description: Returns one page of the Working Set (query of entities|links|excluded, limit, offset, optional at step), masked per the Space's masking mode, with an ETag answering 304 when unchanged. No capability gate; any member or linked-Case member may read it. 422 for a bad of, offset, at or an unsafe id; 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.summary: Data coverage of an Investigation's window
get.description: Names the local calendar days of a window (query from, to, timezone, else the Investigation's latest window op) that have no rows in its bound Dataset, plus per-Collector coverage where the Consignment trail allows. No capability gate; any member or linked-Case member may read it. 422 when the Investigation has no time column, the window is unbounded or over the day cap, or the read fails; 404 when absent or not readable.

get.summary: Compare an Investigation's Working Set across two windows
get.description: Returns the entities and links present in window A only, B only and both (query aFrom, aTo, bFrom, bTo, optional timezone, at, mode presence|activity, minAbsDelta for activity), masked as the Working Set is. Persists nothing. No capability gate; any member or linked-Case member may read it. 422 when a window is missing, mode is unknown, minAbsDelta is used without activity or at is out of range; 404 when absent or not readable.

post.summary: Parse tree of author SQL
post.description: DuckDB's own parse tree for body sql, with fragment statement (default) or predicate; a parse failure is a 200 with ok:false and the error. Nothing is bound or run. No capability gate. 400 for a missing sql or an unknown fragment.

post.summary: Save an Investigation as a template
post.description: Saves the Investigation's effective log as a reusable method: seeds and windows become parameters and case-specific ops are dropped (body optional id, title, pack). Gated on canManageIncidents, and the caller must be a lead. 422 for an unsafe template id or pack, or no effective seed step; 403 when the id escapes the template store or for a non-lead member; 409 when the template id is taken; 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 503 when read-only.

get.description: Returns the template document; only its owner may read it. No capability gate. 422 for an unsafe template id; 404 when it is absent or another owner's; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Instantiate an Investigation template
post.description: Creates a new Investigation from the template, binding its seed parameters and optionally another Dataset with the same column roles (body purpose, params, optional id, title, dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, linkKindCol); every expand reads and seals that Dataset now. Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 for a missing, empty or unknown parameter or a column the Dataset lacks; 404 for an unknown template or Dataset; 409 when the id is taken.

get.summary: Measures over an Investigation's Working Set
get.description: Returns the declared Measures over the Working Set (entity, link, event and excluded counts, deepest hop, links by kind) and optionally one more in Measure shorthand (query relation and measure, given together), exactly what a bound Alert Rule would compute. No capability gate; any member or linked-Case member may read it. 422 for a measure without its relation or an invalid measure; 404 when absent or not readable.

get.summary: Corrected days in an Investigation's window
get.description: Lists the delivery-anomaly Signals (redelivered, renamed correction, part count changed, duplicate skipped) that moved a day inside the Investigation's window since the analyst last looked, attributed to the Dataset through Consignment lineage; assessed false when no Pipeline can be attributed. No capability gate; any member or linked-Case member may read it. 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable.

post.summary: Bind an Alert Rule to an Investigation Measure
post.description: Creates an Alert Rule over one Working Set Measure (body name, optional relation, measure, comparator, threshold, severity; or name, valueMeasure, severity), records the binding and arms it. Gated on canAuthorAlertRules, and the caller must be a lead. 422 for a field outside that shape, an invalid Alert Rule or an unevaluable Measure; 409 when the name is taken; 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 503 when the alert engine is unavailable.

get.summary: Alert Rules bound to an Investigation
get.description: Returns the Alert Rules bound to the Investigation, whether each was edited out of band since binding, and its standing-detection state (enabled, principal, enabledAt, dataset). No capability gate; any member or linked-Case member may read it. 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 503 when the alert engine is unavailable or the control plane is read-only.

Returns the Investigation's optional link to a Case and what it grants the caller; a linked open Case's owner or assignee may read the Investigation. No capability gate; any member or linked-Case member may read it. 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 422 for an unsafe id; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

put.summary: Link an Investigation to a Case
put.description: Links the Investigation to a Case (body caseRef) outside its sealed header, sharing read-only access with the Case's owner and assignee while it stays open. Gated on canManageIncidents, and the caller must be a lead. 422 when caseRef is missing or unsafe; 404 for a Case the caller cannot see, or an Investigation absent or not readable; 409 for a closed Case; 403 for a non-lead member; 503 when read-only.

delete.summary: Unlink an Investigation from its Case
delete.description: Removes the Investigation's Case link, audits the unlink and returns the link status. Gated on canManageIncidents, and the caller must be a lead. 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 403 for a non-lead member; 422 for an unsafe id; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.summary: Export an Investigation's sealed Dossier bundle
get.description: Returns one portable JSON bundle holding the masked Dossier, its references and a custody block, sealed with SHA-256 over its canonical JSON (query at, snapshots); the export is audited. No capability gate; any member or linked-Case member may read it. 422 for a bad at, unsafe id or an unanchored snapshot; 404 when the Investigation or a snapshot is absent or not readable; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Verify a Dossier bundle
post.description: Checks a bundle's seal, its Dossier manifest root and appended references, and the custody of every artefact against the store as it is now (body a bundle, or {bundle}). Persists nothing. No capability gate. 422 when the body is not an inspecto-dossier-bundle/1 bundle or is for another Investigation; 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.description: Returns the Investigation's external references ({system, type, id, url, label}) in the order added, each marked trusted false, with the count and the Space's maximum. No capability gate; any member or linked-Case member may read them. 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 422 for an unsafe id; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Add an external reference to an Investigation
post.description: Appends one pointer to another system (body system, type, id, optional url, label); it is never fetched and grants nothing. Gated on canManageIncidents, and the caller must be a lead. 422 for a missing or invalid field or a url that is not absolute http(s) or embeds credentials; 409 for a duplicate (system, type, id) or a full list; 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 503 when read-only.

get.description: Returns the Investigation's current member roles (lead, analyst, reviewer), the membership history and the caller's own role. No capability gate; any member may read it. 404 for a non-member or an absent Investigation; 422 for an unsafe id; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Grant a role on an Investigation
post.description: Grants or changes a member's role (body subject, role lead|analyst|reviewer). Gated on canManageIncidents, and the caller must be a lead. 422 for an invalid subject or role, or when it would demote the last lead; 403 for a member who is not a lead; 404 for a non-member or absent Investigation; 409 (CONFLICT_STALE_VERSION) when concurrent changes keep winning; 503 when read-only.

post.summary: Revoke a member of an Investigation
post.description: Revokes a member's role (body subject) and the embed links they minted. Gated on canManageIncidents, and the caller must be a lead. 422 for an invalid subject or when it would revoke the last lead; 404 when the subject is not a member or the Investigation is absent or not readable; 403 for a non-lead member; 409 (CONFLICT_STALE_VERSION) when concurrent changes keep winning; 503 when read-only.

get.summary: Evaluate a value Measure over a Dataset
get.description: Runs one named value Measure over a whole Dataset and returns the entities breaching its thresholds in a window (query dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, optional linkKindCol, name, valueCol, timeCol, from and to or last, plus the Measure's thresholds); entities are masked when the Space masks them. No capability gate. 422 for a missing or unsafe query field or an invalid Measure; 404 for an unknown or not-viewable Dataset; 503 when read-only.

get.summary: List the preset queries a Dataset can answer
get.description: LA-PRESET-QUERIES-1. The presets the Space's Industry pack (domain_profile) offers - always the core set, the pack's own first - whose roles the Dataset maps. {dataset, pack, roles {from, to, kind, time, amount} (a column name or null), presets [{id, label, description, kind (aggregate|measure|graph), needs [role], params [{name, label, type (entity|number|kinds|window), default}]}]}. Roles come from the Dataset's defaultLinkMapping, else its first two columns classified as an Entity Type; kind, time and amount are found by name, type and the pack's measure_hints. A preset whose roles are not all mapped is not listed. LA-QUERY-BUILDER-1 adds columns {time [column], measure [{column, unit}]} - the role columns the query builder may name - and saved [{id, label, description, query}]: the Space presets saved from the builder (preset-query components) whose query this Dataset can answer.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.description: The Dataset id.

200.description: The offered presets and the Dataset roles.

404.description: No such Dataset, or one the caller cannot view.

422.description: No 'dataset', or a Dataset that cannot be read.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

post.summary: Run one preset query over a Dataset
post.description: LA-PRESET-QUERIES-1. Body {dataset, params {name: value}}. Declarative, never free SQL: an aggregate preset groups the links by one end over the mapped roles (quoted columns, bound values); a graph preset joins the links to themselves (two_way, short_loops, newcomers, two_steps); a measure preset runs a Value Measure (quick_cash_out = timeToCashOut). Answer {preset, dataset, columns [{id, label, entity}], rows, count, truncated, masking}. Entity columns are exploration aliases when the Space masks; an entity parameter may be such an alias. At most 500 rows (the top parameter, and the Space's entity fence), under the Space's statement timeout. Read-shaped: persists nothing. Audited as LINK_PRESET_RUN.

parameters.name: presetId
parameters.description: The preset id, from GET /inv/presets.

404.description: No such Dataset (or not viewable), or no such preset in this Space's pack.

422.description: No body or dataset, a role the Dataset does not map, an unknown or bad parameter, or an alias this server never minted.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

post.summary: Match a branching pattern over a whole Dataset
post.description: Runs a branching motif (such as structuring) over a whole Dataset (body dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, optional linkKindCol, timeCol, stages, filter, limit) and returns the matches with their legs; a refusal the browser would give is a 200 with refusal. No capability gate. 422 for a missing or unsafe field, an unknown column or a bad filter; 404 for an unknown or not-viewable Dataset; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Scan a Dataset for burst or periodic links
post.description: Finds bursts or periodic series in each link's (or entity's) event times (body dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, timeCol, mode burst|periodicity, optional series, filter, limit, windowSeconds, minEvents, maxCv). No capability gate. 422 for a missing or unsafe field, a bad mode or series, an out-of-range number, an unknown field or column, or a bad filter; 404 for an unknown or not-viewable Dataset; 403 when the scan needs four-eyes approval; 503 when read-only.

post.summary: Accept a profile into an Expectation's baseline
post.description: Accepts a recorded profile (body profileId, default the most recent) into a baseline Expectation's baseline and returns the audit entry. Gated on canOperateRuns. 404 for an unknown Expectation or profile; 422 when the Expectation is not of kind baseline; 409 when already accepted; 503 when the write root is unset or the baseline store is unavailable.

post.summary: Clear an Expectation's baseline
post.description: Un-accepts every accepted profile of a baseline Expectation (history is kept) and returns the audit entry. Gated on canOperateRuns. 404 for an unknown Expectation; 422 when it is not of kind baseline; 503 when the write root is unset or the baseline store is unavailable.

post.summary: POST /components/escalation-rule

day.description: The ONE day to compare (yyyy-mm-dd) of each Dataset's temporal column (columns[].role temporal, else dateField); absent = the latest day present on any side. A Dataset with no temporal column is a 422 (RECON-PERF-1, operator 2026-10-09).

put.description: Stores body postmortem (an object, and nothing else) as the object's postmortem attribute, which resolving an Incident requires; audited with the request's actor. put.summary: Replace an Incident's or Case's typed financial impact (WS-10)
put.description: Gated on canWorkIncidents. Body {impact:{...}} and nothing else; {} clears the impact. Audited as an OBJECT_ACTIVITY impact event with the stored value before and after.
