Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 for a missing reason, a malformed or masked key, a type not in force, an empty value, or two keys equal after normalising; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.summary: Identity group of one Entity key
get.description: Returns the identity group of one typed, normalised Entity key (query key, optional at); a key in no live assertion resolves to a one-member group. Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 when key is not a typed Entity key or at is invalid; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 for a missing or unsafe field, equal or unknown columns, a type the columns do not support or a bad limit; 404 for an unknown or not-viewable Dataset; 403 when it needs four-eyes approval; 503 when read-only.

post.summary: Retract an identity assertion
post.description: Retracts the identity assertion at the given log seq (body reason) and returns the groups of its two keys afterwards. Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 for a missing reason or a seq that is not an integer of at least 1; 409 when no assertion is at that seq or it is already retracted; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.description: The per-kind maker-checker policy persisted as `approval.toon` in the Space's config tree, plus the read-only facts a policy editor needs: `governable` (the kinds a policy may name), `defaultApproverCapability` and `failedClosed`. Open to any caller (reads are not capability-gated). Default OFF: no file (or no write root) reads as an empty `approval` map with `expiresAfterHours` 168. A file that is present but unreadable or invalid is NOT read as off — it holds every governable kind with the defaults and reports `failedClosed: true`; `approval` is then empty and the held kinds are exactly those in `governable`.

put.description: Replaces `approval.toon` wholesale and returns the policy as GET reads it. Requires canAdminister (not canAuthorWorkbench: turning maker-checker off is the one change an author must not be able to make), and is itself never held for approval. Validated fail-closed: an unknown key, a kind outside `governable`, an `approverCapability` no route demands, `expiresAfterHours` outside 1..8784, a non-boolean flag, or a policy requiring approval on a build with no Authenticator is refused. Lenient scalars: `expiresAfterHours` also accepts its string form (`"168"`), the boolean flags accept `"true"`/`"false"`, and a missing or blank `approverCapability` falls back to `canApproveChanges`. An empty or absent body is refused (422): turning four-eyes off must be explicit, `{"approval": {}}`. With no Authenticator configured the route is refused outright (403), so the policy can never be switched off unauthenticated — a Basic install cannot change it through the API (operator, 2026-09-28). Emits one `approval-policy.changed` audit event carrying the policy before and after.

requestBody.description: Required: an empty or absent body is 422. Send `{"approval": {}}` to turn every hold off.

approval.description: Kind (one of `governable`) → rule. Omitted or empty = OFF.

expiresAfterHours.description: How long a Pending Change waits before it is recorded `expired`.

200.description: The policy was written; the effective policy as GET reads it.

403.description: The caller lacks canAdminister, or no Authenticator is configured at all (PERMISSION_DENIED) — the route is never served unauthenticated.

400.description: The body is not a JSON object (MALFORMED_REQUEST).

422.description: The body is empty or absent, or the policy is refused by validation (CONFIG_VALIDATION_FAILED); `error.message` names the offending key.

503.description: No write root is configured (CONTROL_PLANE_READ_ONLY) — set -Dassist.write.root to enable.

get.description: Every Pending Change of the Space, newest first, without content (`current` / `proposed` / `request` are omitted — GET /pending-changes/{id} reads them). Open to any caller (reads are not capability-gated). A still-pending change past its `expiresAt` is recorded `expired` as it is read. At most 500 items are returned; `total` is the true count after filtering and `truncated` says whether items were cut. With no write root the list is empty.

503.description: The store is locked beyond the wait bound (STORE_BUSY) — retry.

get.summary: Read one Pending Change with its content
get.description: The full record: the summary fields plus `current` (what the change replaces, null for a create) and `proposed` (what it writes, null for a delete), and the method + path it was proposed through (the raw request body is never served). A record whose MAC does not verify is shown with `status: invalid` and `integrity: invalid`. Expired on read like the list.

parameters.name: pendingchangeId
parameters.description: The Pending Change id, `pc-<yyyyMMddHHmmss>-<6 hex>`; any other shape is 422.

post.summary: Approve a Pending Change and apply it
post.description: Requires canApproveChanges (the route) and then the kind's `approverCapability` (in the handler). Gates in order: canApproveChanges 403 → no authenticated Subject 403 → write root 503 → `reason` over 500 chars 422 → unsafe id 422 → unknown 404 → MAC does not verify 409 → not pending (decided, withdrawn or expired) 409 → the kind's approverCapability 403 → with `fourEyes`, the author approving their own change 403. The original request is then replayed through the route it was proposed through, AS ITS AUTHOR with their authority re-checked now; only a replay that writes exactly the approved content applies. Decided under a cross-process compare-and-set: of two concurrent decisions one wins, the other is 409.

parameters.name: pendingchangeId
parameters.description: The Pending Change id, `pc-<yyyyMMddHHmmss>-<6 hex>`; any other shape is 422.

200.description: Applied: `applied: true`, the change `approved`, and `result` carrying the replayed route's own status and body.

403.description: canApproveChanges or the kind's approverCapability missing; no authenticated Subject (an author and a decider cannot be told apart — Basic, which has no Authenticator, is always refused here); the author deciding their own four-eyes change; or the author no longer holds what the change needs (PERMISSION_DENIED).

409.description: Already decided, withdrawn or expired; integrity check failed; the recorded request is not a maker-checker route; or the target changed since the change was proposed — the change is then closed `stale` (CONFLICT).

422.description: Unsafe id or `reason` over 500 chars (CONFIG_VALIDATION_FAILED); a replay refused by its route with 422 comes back as that 422 and leaves the change pending.

503.description: Write root unset (CONTROL_PLANE_READ_ONLY), or the store locked beyond the wait bound (STORE_BUSY).

post.summary: Decline a Pending Change
post.description: Closes the change `declined`, unapplied; the target is free for a new proposal. Gates as approve up to and including four-eyes (an author may not decline their own four-eyes change — they withdraw it). Audited as `pending-change.declined`.

parameters.name: pendingchangeId
parameters.description: The Pending Change id, `pc-<yyyyMMddHHmmss>-<6 hex>`; any other shape is 422.

200.description: Declined: `applied: false`, the change `declined` with `decidedBy`, `decidedAt` and `decisionReason`.

403.description: canApproveChanges or the kind's approverCapability missing; no authenticated Subject (an author and a decider cannot be told apart — Basic, which has no Authenticator, is always refused here); or the author deciding their own four-eyes change (PERMISSION_DENIED).

409.description: Already decided, withdrawn or expired, or the integrity check failed (CONFLICT).

422.description: Unsafe id or `reason` over 500 chars (CONFIG_VALIDATION_FAILED).

503.description: Write root unset (CONTROL_PLANE_READ_ONLY), or the store locked beyond the wait bound (STORE_BUSY).

post.summary: Withdraw your own Pending Change
post.description: The AUTHOR takes back a change they proposed: it closes `withdrawn`, unapplied, signed and audited (`pending-change.withdrawn`) as a decline is. No capability is needed — only the Subject who proposed it may withdraw it. Gates in order: no authenticated Subject (an author and a decider cannot be told apart — Basic, which has no Authenticator, is always refused here) 403 → write root 503 → `reason` over 500 chars 422 → unsafe id 422 → unknown 404 → integrity 409 → not pending (decided, withdrawn or expired) 409 → the caller is not the author 403. Same cross-process compare-and-set as approve: a withdraw racing an approve leaves exactly one outcome.

parameters.name: pendingchangeId
parameters.description: The Pending Change id, `pc-<yyyyMMddHHmmss>-<6 hex>`; any other shape is 422.

200.description: Withdrawn: `applied: false`, the change `withdrawn` with `decidedBy` = the author.

403.description: No authenticated Subject (an author and a decider cannot be told apart — Basic, which has no Authenticator, is always refused here), or the caller is not the change's author (PERMISSION_DENIED).

409.description: Already decided, withdrawn or expired, or the integrity check failed (CONFLICT).

422.description: Unsafe id or `reason` over 500 chars (CONFIG_VALIDATION_FAILED).

503.description: Write root unset (CONTROL_PLANE_READ_ONLY), or the store locked beyond the wait bound (STORE_BUSY).

post.description: Saves a pending outbound call raised from one Incident or Case (body connection, payloadTemplate, incidentId or caseId, optional method, idempotencyKey, reason, context) for four-eyes approval. post.summary: Preview one entity's Risk Score under a saved or unsaved model, writing nothing
post.description: ASSURE-RISK-SCORE-RESIDUALS-1 S3. Gated on canWorkIncidents; unsaved content also needs canAuthorWorkbench. Body: exactly one of model (a saved id) or content (a risk-score model), plus entityKey (1-256 chars). Every factor is narrowed to the entity; evaluation is bounded (one row per indicator, 3 evidence rows per factor, a 10 s sandbox timeout). No scores Dataset, Signal or watch-list entry is written. Classified evidence is masked; the entity key is masked unless the caller holds canRevealLinkEntities.

get.description: ASSURE-RISK-SCORE-1. Gated on canWorkIncidents. An unknown model, a model outside the caller's data scopes, a row the policy engine denies, or no score for the entity are all 404 (existence-hiding). score = sum of factor contributions (weight x indicator, held to cap), clamped 0-100; every score is recomputable from its factors. The entity key is returned as the Space masked: token (keyMasked: true) unless the caller holds canRevealLinkEntities; classified evidence is masked at write time. The entityKey may be a masked: alias: the Space key's, or with ?investigation= that Investigation's, resolved only after its read gate (LA-SUSPICION-FACTORS-INVESTIGATION-1).

200.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {model, entityType, entityKey, score, high, highThreshold, modelVersion, runId, scoredAt, factors[{indicator, label, value, missing, weight, cap, capped, contribution, evidence[]}]}

get.summary: Evaluate a KPI definition for the period to date
get.description: Evaluates the `kpi` registry component's Measure over the current `grain` period to date and over the SAME elapsed length of the comparison period (KpiEvaluator), in ONE explicit zone: the KPI's `timezone`, else UTC. A read, so ungated. 503 write root unset · 400 unsafe id or bad `asOf` · 404 unknown or shared-away KPI, and a Dataset that is absent OR unreadable by the caller (the same answer on purpose) · 422 a stored KPI that no longer validates, or a failed relation / DuckDB read.

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: The day the period runs to (inclusive): YYYY-MM-DD, or an ISO instant read as its date in the KPI's zone. Absent: today in that zone. A future day, one before year 1, or an unplaceable instant is a 400. Ignored when from and to are sent.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD) of a range to read the KPI over instead of the grain's period to date. Send with to. The comparison is the equal-length period before the range (or the same dates a year earlier, or none, as the KPI declares).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD) of the range; the answer's asOf is this day. Send with from. 400 when only one of from and to is sent, when from is after to, for a future day, a malformed day, or a span over 3660 days.

200.description: The KPI's value, comparison and RAG band.

post.summary: Create a KPI definition from a delivered kpi Requirement
post.description: An explicit authoring action — delivering a Requirement never creates a KPI by itself. Requires canAuthorWorkbench (403 PERMISSION_DENIED otherwise). The Requirement supplies what Business authored on it: `title`, `target`, `unit`, and the good `direction` read off its `comparator` (>= / > → up, <= / < → down); the body supplies what only a Builder knows. Body keys win. The KPI is saved through the same gate as /components/kpi (KpiRoutes.requireMeasure: the Dataset exists and is readable by the author, the measure field and `timeField` are in its Schema, `timeField` is DATE/TIMESTAMP/TIMESTAMPTZ), then the maker-checker hold, then the write, and the Requirement is stamped `kpi: <id>`. 503 write root unset · 404 unknown Requirement · 422 unsafe id, not a kpi Requirement, an invalid KPI or a Measure that does not exist for this author · 409 not delivered, already created one, or a KPI of that id exists.

200.description: The KPI written — its stored content, with `name` = the KPI id and `requirement` = the Requirement id.

202.description: Held by the Space's Approval Policy for `kpi` — nothing was written, and the Requirement is not stamped until the Pending Change is approved (the approval replays this request).

pendingChange.description: The Pending Change record without its content (id, kind, name, operation, status, author, createdAt, expiresAt, approverCapability, fourEyes, …) — GET /pending-changes/{id} reads it in full.

403.description: The caller lacks canAuthorWorkbench (PERMISSION_DENIED) — Standard and Advanced only.

get.description: Recomputes the Space's audit hash chain over an optional seq range (query from, to; epoch=current) and returns ok or the first bad seq with its reason; a broken chain is still a 200. Gated on canAdminister. 400 when from or to is not a positive integer or from is after to.

Returns the Space's signed audit anchors, oldest first, each with its MAC verdict; the newest limit (default 1000, at most 10000) with total and truncated. Gated on canAdminister. 503 when the write root is unset.

post.summary: Anchor the audit chain now
post.description: Writes a signed audit anchor now and returns {created, anchor}; created is false when nothing was chained since the last anchor. Gated on canAdminister. 409 when events are in memory only or the chain or anchor file does not verify; 429 when called again within the minimum interval; 503 when the write root is unset.

post.summary: Rebaseline a broken audit chain
post.description: Records the operator's acknowledged break as a signed BREAK anchor with body reason (at most 500 characters) and an audit event; it repairs nothing. Gated on canAdminister. 422 for a missing or over-long reason; 409 when there is nothing to rebaseline or events are in memory only; 429 when repeated within a minute; 503 when the write root is unset.

post.summary: Push NDJSON or CSV records into a Stream's inbox (ASSURE-PUSH-INGEST-1)
post.description: Lands the body as ONE server-named file in the inbox of the Pipeline the Stream's Collector feeds; the ordinary Collector path ingests it. Gated canOperateRuns; per-caller rate limit; optional Idempotency-Key (a replay returns the first result, a concurrent duplicate is 409). Byte cap -Dstreams.push.max_bytes (default 8 MiB), record cap -Dstreams.push.max_records (default 100000). A refusal lands nothing. Not a config write: no write-root gate, no approval hold.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The Collector id (the id GET /catalog/streams lists).

schema.description: RFC 4180 rows, the Pipeline's delimiter; every row the first row's field count.

201.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {stream, pipeline, file, records, bytes}. A replay carries Idempotency-Replayed: true.

404.description: No such Stream.

409.description: pipeline paused (paused or not active), an authoring template, or the same caller's Idempotency-Key still in flight.

413.description: Over the byte or record cap, or a keyed push over the 1 MiB idempotency hash window.

422.description: Not UTF-8, a malformed line (named), no records, or the Pipeline's file_pattern would never ingest the format.

429.description: The caller's push budget is spent.

501.description: A Dataset-fed Pipeline has no inbox.

get.description: Returns every Entity List of the Space (retired ones included) as summaries, with the fact log's headSeq and headHash. No capability gate. 503 when the control plane is read-only; 500 when the fact chain is broken.

post.summary: Create an Entity List
post.description: Creates a named set of typed Entity keys (body title, purpose allow|block|watch|exclusion, entityType, reason, optional id; an exclusion list may carry ownerKind, autoApply, visibility); answers 201. Gated on canManageIncidents, plus canManageExclusionCategories for an admin-owned list. 422 for a bad title, purpose, Entity Type, id or attribute; 409 when the id was ever used; 403 for an admin list without that capability; 503 when read-only.

get.description: Returns the list's summary and members as of a log position (query at, default the head) with atSeq and headHash; members are masked per the Space's masking mode, and a restricted list hides them from a caller without the reveal or exclusion-category capability. No capability gate. 422 for a bad at; 404 for an unknown list; 503 when read-only.

post.summary: Change an Entity List's members
post.description: Adds and removes members (body add, remove, addRanges, removeRanges, optional expiresAt, reason) and returns the list with changed; under an approval policy the change may be held as a Pending Change. Gated on canManageIncidents, plus canManageExclusionCategories for an admin-owned list. 422 for a bad value, range, expiresAt, too many values or a key in both add and remove; 404 for an unknown list; 409 when retired; 503 when read-only.

post.summary: Retire an Entity List
post.description: Retires the list (body reason); its id is never reused. Under an approval policy the retirement may be held as a Pending Change. Gated on canManageIncidents, plus canManageExclusionCategories for an admin-owned list. 404 for an unknown list; 409 when already retired; 422 for a missing reason; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Match values against an Entity List
post.description: Reports for each value (body values, 1 to 5000 strings, masked aliases accepted) whether it matches a live member or range of the list, and which. Read-shaped, persists nothing. No capability gate. 422 when values is empty, too long or invalid; 404 for an unknown list; 403 for a restricted list when the caller may not see its members; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.summary: The graph-algorithm catalogue and run limits
get.description: LA separation D-4. The 29 server-side graph algorithms ({id, label, description, cost, inlineNodeCeiling, params[] {name, label, description, type, default, min?, max?, allowed?, allowedLabels?, maxSize?}, needsWeights, needsSource, needsTarget, needsNode, resultKind, engines[]}; `engines` lists "memory" and, for neighborhood, egoNetwork and degreeCentrality, "index"), the hard server `ceilings`, the Space's effective default `defaults` (the `graph_run` settings, clamped to the ceilings; `clamped` says so), the worker `pool`, the `inlineWaitMs` and `resultItems` {limit, default, ceiling, clamped}: the most entries any one list of a run's result carries (the Space's `graph_run.max_result_items`, clamped to the ceiling). A read: no capability.

post.summary: Start a graph run over an Investigation's Working Set
post.description: LA separation D-4. Body {investigationId, input?: "workingSet"|"index", at?, algorithm, params?, weights: "count"|"none", kinds?, budget?{maxNodes,maxEdges,timeoutMs}}. `input` defaults to "workingSet" (today's behaviour, unchanged). With "index" (D-3 step 7; needs the Space setting index.enabled and a current, fitting edge index) the body also takes dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, linkKindCol? (as /inv/projection/neighbors) and, for degreeCentrality only, seeds[1..20]; it runs neighborhood (hops <= 2), egoNetwork or a SEEDS-ONLY degreeCentrality from one pinned index version, at most 20 keys looked up per level, and the response carries source {kind: "index", version, stale, staleReason?, fingerprint} and input {kind: "index", estimated: true, version}. Every case the index cannot serve exactly is a 422 naming the cause (index_disabled, no_index, an unfit mapping or column, index_stale_refused, a non-native algorithm, hops > 2, seeds > 20, `at`, an Investigation that hides entities) - it never falls back to the Working Set; a walk that reaches past the cap is a BUDGET_EXCEEDED run naming it. Gated on canRunLinkGraphAnalysis. A Working Set within the algorithm's inlineNodeCeiling is waited for briefly and answered 200 with the run and its result; a larger one is a 202 with a Location to poll. A run already terminal at submit (BUDGET_EXCEEDED, or a result-cache hit) is a 200. BUDGET_EXCEEDED carries the budget, the measured consumed size and a reason - and never a `result` key. Entity ids in a result are masked per the Space's maskingMode, edge ids included.

200.description: The run, terminal (COMPLETED with its `result`; or BUDGET_EXCEEDED / CANCELLED / FAILED without one).

202.description: Accepted; poll the run at the Location header. No `result`.

404.description: No such Investigation, or not readable by the caller.

422.description: Unknown algorithm or field, a bad or missing parameter, a bad budget or `at`, an unknown `input`, or an `input: "index"` run the index cannot serve (the cause is named).

503.description: No write root, or the run queue is full (STORE_BUSY).

get.description: LA separation D-4. `?investigationId=` narrows to one Investigation (404 as a read of it would). Only the caller's own runs, and only those whose Investigation the caller can still read. Views carry no `result`.

404.description: `investigationId` names no readable Investigation.

503.description: No write root.

get.description: LA separation D-4. Status, progress ({work, fraction, known}: `fraction` is the algorithm's own live 0..1 and is meaningful only when `known` is true, else 0 means unknown; a COMPLETED run that reports one shows 1), the budget in force, what was consumed (`elapsedMs` is live while RUNNING and final at the end), `cached`,`exceeded` + `reason` (BUDGET_EXCEEDED), `failure` (FAILED, the exception class only) and, only when COMPLETED, the masked `result`. Each list in a result is cut to the Space's `max_result_items` (top of the canonical-v1 order): `result.truncated` is true when any list was cut and `result.lists.<name> = {total, returned, limit, truncated}` gives every top-level list's full count (a nested list, such as one group, appears only when cut) - a cut is never silent, and the cached result stays whole. A run another caller started, or one whose Investigation the caller can no longer read, is absent.

404.description: No such run for this caller.

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: Cancel a graph run
post.description: LA separation D-4. The run's starter or an administrator (canAdminister); the run ends CANCELLED at its next checkpoint (a queued run at once). No capability beyond that; the Investigation's read access is re-checked.

404.description: No such run - and the same answer when the caller is neither the starter nor an administrator, or can no longer read the run's Investigation (no existence signal).

503.description: No write root.

get.summary: List the edge/node indexes of the caller's viewable Datasets
get.description: LA separation D-3 step 4. {enabled, indexes, total}: `enabled` echoes the Space's index.enabled (default TRUE since 2026-10-10; an explicit false disables; when on, POST /inv/traversal/recursive-paths answers from a current index within the depth/frontier cap). Each index: dataset, mappingHash, mapping {sourceCol,targetCol,kindCol,timeCol,timeColZone,weightCol,attrCols}, version (the CURRENT one), builtAt, builder, rows (edges per direction), nodes, bytes (all tables), droppedNull (rows dropped for a NULL endpoint), tables {name: {rows, files, bytes}}, versions [{version, bytes, current}] (the retained published versions, newest first; bytes = tables + appended deltas), buckets, deltas (appended file groups the version carries), a `plan` (D-3 step 8: {recommended: none|append|full|compact, appendable, reasons, added, removed, changed + a sample of up to 20 paths each} - what differs between the version and the Dataset now and which build would close the gap; advice only, nothing is built by reading it), and `stale` + `reason` (why it is out of date, in the plain words every screen shows: the Dataset's files or its definition changed after the index was built, or it was built by another version of Inspecto or of DuckDB - an out-of-date index is still listed). Only Datasets the caller may view are walked: an index over a Dataset the caller cannot view is absent from the answer. No capability.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

post.summary: Start an edge/node index build over a Dataset
post.description: LA separation D-3 step 4. Body {dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, kindCol?, timeCol?, timeColZone?, weightCol?, attrCols?, mode?}. `mode` (D-3 step 8) is `full` (default; rebuild from the Dataset), `append` (add ONLY the input files added since the live version, as a delta, published as the NEXT immutable version; refused 409 when a covered file was removed, superseded or rewritten, the relation SQL or bucket function changed, nothing was added, the Dataset is not a plain row-wise store read, or the version already carries 8 deltas) or `compact` (merge the live version's deltas into one sorted main; refused 409 when it has none). Nothing appends or compacts on its own: GET /inv/index only advises. Gated on canBuildLinkIndex (a build spends compute and disk). The Dataset gate runs first, exactly as for a projection: an unknown Dataset is 404 and a Dataset the caller may not view is the SAME 404. A build whose estimate (rows x 34 bytes x 2) is above the Space's index.max_disk_bytes (0 or unset = no limit) is refused up front with the estimate in the message. One live build per (Dataset, mapping): a second start is 409. Always 202 with a Location to poll; the build runs on its own DuckDB connection and publishes an immutable version under <Space write root>/la-index.

202.description: Accepted; poll the build at the Location header. {buildId, status, dataset, mappingHash, progress, ...}.

404.description: No such Dataset, or not viewable by the caller (the same answer).

409.description: The same index (Dataset + mapping) is already building, or an `append` / `compact` is not applicable now (the message names why and the way forward).

422.description: Unknown or missing field, an unknown mode, a column the Dataset does not have, a bad time zone, or an estimate over index.max_disk_bytes.

503.description: No write root, or the build queue is full (STORE_BUSY).

get.description: LA separation D-3 step 4. Status (QUEUED, RUNNING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, FAILED), the builder's progress {phase, step, steps}, cancelRequested, `failure` (FAILED: the exception class only, never a message) and, when COMPLETED, `result` {version, rows, edges, droppedNull, nodes, buckets, bytes, totalMs}. A build another caller started, or one over a Dataset the caller can no longer view, is absent.

404.description: No such build for this caller.

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: Cancel an index build
post.description: LA separation D-3 step 4. The build's starter or an administrator (canAdminister); a running build is cancelled through the builder (nothing is published, the stage is deleted), a queued one at once. No capability beyond that.

404.description: No such build - and the same answer when the caller is neither the starter nor an administrator, or can no longer view the build's Dataset (no existence signal).

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: Fork a Draft of an Investigation
post.description: Creates the caller's own working copy forked from the main log (body optional at step, label); one live Draft per member. Gated on canManageIncidents; a lead or analyst. 403 for a role that does not fork; 422 for a bad at or label; 409 when the member already has a live Draft, the Space is full or the id is taken; 404 for a non-member; 503 when read-only or the Draft store is busy.

get.description: Returns the caller's own Drafts of the Investigation (a lead or reviewer sees all), live ones only unless query discarded=true. No capability gate; the caller must be a member. 404 for a non-member or an absent Investigation; 422 for an unsafe id; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

Returns the Draft's header, head step and whether the main log has moved on since it forked. No capability gate; the Draft's actor, or a lead or reviewer. 404 for a non-member, an unknown Draft or another analyst's Draft; 422 for a malformed Draft id.

Returns the Draft's own log entries (the steps after the base it forked from). No capability gate; the Draft's actor, or a lead or reviewer. 404 for a non-member, an unknown Draft or another analyst's Draft; 409 when the Draft was discarded, promoted or expired, or the main log's forked prefix changed; 422 for a malformed Draft id.

Returns one page of the Draft's Working Set (query of entities|links|excluded, limit, offset, at), served as the main Working Set route serves it. No capability gate; the Draft's actor, or a lead or reviewer. 404 for a non-member or an unknown or unreadable Draft; 409 when the Draft is closed or its base changed; 422 for a malformed id or bad query.

Re-folds the main prefix plus the Draft's own steps from scratch and reports any step whose recorded hash or persisted set hash no longer matches. No capability gate; the Draft's actor, or a lead or reviewer. 404 for a non-member or an unknown or unreadable Draft; 409 when the Draft is closed or its base changed; 422 for a malformed Draft id.

post.summary: Append a step to a Draft
post.description: Appends one op to the Draft with the same validation and sealing as the main log (body op plus its params). Gated on canManageIncidents; the Draft's actor only. 403 for a lead or reviewer who is not its actor; 404 for a non-member or an unknown Draft; 409 when the Draft is closed, its base changed or its index pin expired (rebase first); 422 for an invalid op.

post.summary: Undo the latest Draft step
post.description: Revert the newest effective step of the Draft's own ops (a recorded undo entry). Optional body {undoes: step} names the step the caller means to revert (LA-GROW-EXCLUDE-UNDO-RACE-1): when another step is the newest by now the answer is 409 CONFLICT_STALE_VERSION naming it and nothing is written; undoes not a whole number from 1 is 422. Without a body the newest step is undone. 409 CONFLICT when there is nothing to undo. Gated on canManageIncidents; only the Draft's actor may undo: 403 for a lead or reviewer who is not.

undoes.description: The step the caller means to undo; 409 when it is not the newest effective step.

post.summary: Discard a Draft
post.description: Closes the Draft with an audit marker, deletes its log and sealed sets, and releases its index pins; a repeat answers alreadyDiscarded. Gated on canManageIncidents; the Draft's actor or a lead. 403 for anyone else who can see it; 404 for a non-member or an unknown Draft; 409 when the Draft was promoted; 422 for a malformed Draft id.

get.summary: Conflicts a Draft rebase would meet
get.description: Returns the conflict report a rebase of the Draft onto the current main head would produce; writes nothing. No capability gate; the Draft's actor, or a lead or reviewer. 404 for a non-member or an unknown or unreadable Draft; 409 when the Draft is closed or its base changed; 422 for a malformed Draft id.

post.summary: Rebase a Draft onto the main head
post.description: Replays the Draft's effective ops over the current main head, re-pins index versions and swaps the result in (body optional confirm list of superseded or blocked steps, expectHead). Gated on canManageIncidents; the Draft's actor only. 409 when expectHead is not the head or a conflict is unconfirmed, or the Draft is closed; 422 for a bad confirm or expectHead; 403 for a non-actor; 404 for a non-member or unknown Draft.

post.summary: Promote a Draft into the main log
post.description: Appends the Draft's effective ops to the main log atomically (body optional expectHead); a promote carrying a sensitive expand is held as a pending four-eyes request (202). Gated on canManageIncidents; the Draft's actor or a lead. 409 when expectHead is not the head, the Draft must rebase first or is closed; 422 when it has no ops or expectHead is bad; 403 for anyone else; 404 for a non-member or unknown Draft.

get.description: Returns the Space's effective Safety Policy, each field naming the tier that constrained it; an unreadable policy file answers readable:false with the reason instead. Gated on canAdminister.

post.summary: Register an Entity List's sidecar as a Dataset
post.description: ASSURE-ENTITY-LISTS-RESIDUALS-1 (3). The explicit, manual action that creates the Dataset `entity_list_<id>` (`physicalRef: entity_list_<id>`) over the list's Parquet sidecar, through the same validated save path as a hand-authored Dataset (POST /components/dataset). No body. A list write never registers a Dataset; only this call does. Needs canAuthorWorkbench (the Dataset-authoring capability). Gates: no write root 503; unknown list 404; no sidecar on disk (no data root, or no list write since) 409; a Dataset of that id already exists 409 (never rewritten, so a repeat is safe); an approval policy for kind `dataset` 409 (refused, not held); the Dataset gate 422. No path-jail 403: the only path is built from a validated list id.

201.description: Registered. Envelope data `{listId, datasetId, physicalRef, dataset}`; `dataset` is the stored component as POST /components/dataset answers it.

404.description: No such Entity List.

409.description: No sidecar on disk, a Dataset of that id already exists, or the Space's approval policy governs Datasets. Nothing was written.

503.description: No write root, or Entity Lists are not installed in this edition.

post.summary: Enable standing detection for a bound Alert Rule
post.description: Records the owner's authority so a bound value-measure Alert Rule (body rule) keeps reading the live Dataset, re-decided at every Alert sweep. Gated on canAuthorAlertRules; the Investigation's owner only. 422 for another body field, an unsafe name, a non-value-measure Alert Rule or refused authority; 403 for a caller who is not the owner; 404 for an Alert Rule not armed or not bound here; 409 when it was edited since binding; 503 when the alert engine is unavailable.

get.description: Returns the caller's own Investigation templates, newest first, as summaries (id, title, pack, createdAt, dataset, investigation, and counts of parameters and ops). No capability gate. 503 when the control plane is read-only.

delete.summary: Disable standing detection for a bound Alert Rule
delete.description: Drops the recorded authority of the named bound Alert Rule, so every sweep refuses it; the Alert Rule stays bound and armed. Idempotent. Gated on canAuthorAlertRules, and the caller must be a lead. 422 for an unsafe Alert Rule name; 404 when it is not bound to this Investigation or the Investigation is absent or not readable; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

put.summary: Edit an Investigation's bound Alert Rule
put.description: Replaces a bound Alert Rule in place with the binding route's body (name, when given, must equal the path's); the binding takes the new Alert Rule's hash and loses its standing-detection authority. Gated on canAuthorAlertRules, and the caller must be a lead. 422 for a different name, a body outside the shape or an invalid Alert Rule; 404 when it is not armed or not bound here; 409 when it was edited out of band; 503 when the alert engine is unavailable.

get.summary: Data as of for a Dataset
get.description: The newest value of the Dataset's eventDate column as an ISO-8601 dataAsOf (null with a reason when it cannot be read) plus the verdicts of its freshness Alert Rules; with no write root it answers dataAsOf null. No capability gate; the Dataset's view access applies. 404 for an unknown or shared-away Dataset; 400 for an id the store refuses.

Returns the installed-module topology: each module's id, build and offering roles, state with reasons, whether it is enabled in this Space, what it provides and requires; not-installed known modules; manifest diagnostics; and the Space's inert references. Carries an ETag. No capability gate.

Returns {disabled, inert, installed, unreadable}: the feature ids switched off in this Space, stored ids no installed module declares, every installable feature id, and whether the document is unreadable. No capability gate.

put.description: Replaces the Space's disabled feature list with body disabled and audits before and after; a disabled module's routes then answer 404 MODULE_DISABLED. Gated on canAdminister. 422 for an unknown key, a non-list, more than 200 entries or an id that is not a feature of an installed module; 503 when the write root is unset.

get.summary: The Product's Apps, the Apps installed live, and the trusted signers (PRODUCT-ASSEMBLY-1 PA-7d)
get.description: shipped: the build's own Apps; installed: [{id, title, version, signedBy, installedAt, templates}]; signers: the key ids an App package may be signed with (the issuer keys plus conf/app-signers.properties); liveInstall: whether this server is a Product build of a Platform product (a write still needs a Spaces root: 503 without one).

post.summary: Install a signed App package (canAdminister; PA-7d)
post.description: The body is the package zip (tools/inspecto-app.mjs package --key). 503 no Spaces root; 409 not a Platform product build, the App is installed already or ships with the build, or a template collides; 422 a package that does not verify (signature, manifest, an untrusted signer), the App's Platform range, or an Add-on the entitlement leaves out; 423 read-only. The answer is the plan (templates and files added, nav) plus installed.

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: true: answer the plan (templates, files, nav, and on an upgrade each Space's offered difference) and change nothing.

put.summary: Upgrade an installed App (canAdminister; PA-7d, D-PA25)
put.description: The body is the new package. Replaces the App's templates and nav (new Spaces get the new version); a Space already made from it is never changed - the answer offers each one its file-by-file difference (new / update / customised / dropped), applied through the normal config routes. Gates as POST /apps, plus 404-as-409 when not installed.

delete.description: Takes the App's templates (only those it installed) and nav away. Spaces made from it keep every file and are named in spacesKept. 400 when {id} is not an App id; 404 when not installed live (an App the build ships is not removed here).

post.summary: Acknowledge an Alert
post.description: Acknowledges a stored Alert by the id GET /alerts returns, attributed to the caller (or body actor on Basic). Gated on canWorkIncidents. 404 for an unknown Alert; 422 when its state does not allow it; 503 when the alert engine is unavailable.

post.summary: Resolve an Alert
post.description: Resolves a stored Alert by the id GET /alerts returns, attributed to the caller (or body actor on Basic). Gated on canWorkIncidents. 404 for an unknown Alert; 422 when its state does not allow it; 503 when the alert engine is unavailable.

post.summary: Preview one entity's Anomaly Score under a saved or unsaved model, writing nothing
post.description: ANOMALY-DETECTION-1 S4. Gated on canWorkIncidents; unsaved content also needs canAuthorWorkbench. Body: exactly one of model (a saved id) or content (an anomaly-model), plus entityKey (1-256 chars) and optional asOf (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC; the day before it is scored, default today). Every feature is narrowed to the entity by a bound filter; evaluation is bounded (one entity, a 10 s / 512 MB sandbox). No scores Dataset, Signal or watch-list entry is written. The entity key is masked unless the caller holds canRevealLinkEntities. A feature that declares evidence columns adds evidence[] (up to 3 origin rows of the scored day) to the entity's top feature, classified columns masked as the Job stores them.

200.description: Envelope-wrapped: data = {model, entityType, entityKey, keyMasked, found, periodStart, score, band, raw, elevatedThreshold, highThreshold, insufficientCount, saved, series{featureId: {points[{day, value}] (the history window then the scored day, value null when absent), median, low, high (median +/- bandSpreads x max(scaled MAD, floor); null when the baseline is insufficient), bandSpreads}} (additive; {} when the entity is not found), features[{feature, label, bucket, observed, baseline{kind, median, mad, points, season}, unit, zSelf, deviation, direction, weight, contribution, share, insufficient, reason, evidence[]?}]}

400.description: Not exactly one of model/content, a missing or over-long entityKey, or a bad asOf.

403.description: The caller lacks canWorkIncidents, or canAuthorWorkbench for unsaved content, or previews content outside its data scopes.

404.description: The saved model is unknown, unparseable or outside the caller's data scopes.

422.description: The content fails the save-time checks, or a feature query fails.

503.description: No Space write or data root.

get.summary: The latest Anomaly Score of one entity under a saved anomaly-model, with its explanation and recent runs
get.description: ANOMALY-DETECTION-1 S4. Gated on canWorkIncidents. An unknown model, a model outside the caller's data scopes, a row the policy engine denies, or no score for the entity are all 404 (existence-hiding). score = 100 x (1 - exp(-raw / scale)) over the weighted RMS of per-feature robust z (D-AD6); every score is recomputable from its features. history lists the last 30 runs, newest first. The entity key is returned as the Space masked: token (keyMasked: true) unless the caller holds canRevealLinkEntities.

Answers {items[{class, masked, source, entityType?, label?}]}, sorted by class: every column classification this Space knows, the same list a save refuses an unknown class by (422 ERR_UNKNOWN_CLASSIFICATION). source is sensitive (MSISDN, IMSI, ACCOUNT, PII), entity-type (a class an Entity Type of the Space claims, or the id of one) or not-masked (INTERNAL); entityType and label name the Entity Type that claims the class, when one does. masked says whether a column of the class is masked for a reader who may not reveal it: a sensitive class, a class a masked Entity Type claims, or the id of a masked Entity Type. Read-only and not capability-gated (reads are open to the Space).

get.summary: What reads one mapped column of a Schema (column impact, report-only)
get.description: SPACE-LINK-CENSUS-1 LC-5. Every config that reads {columnId} as the Schema {schemaId} publishes it (its mapping.fields), from the link census: Dataset dateField and calculated expressions, Widget controls fields, Expectation column / refColumn / condition fields, Decision Rule condition fields, Reconciliation keyColumns / compareColumns / impact.column, and the column references of Enrichment transform, Query text and virtual Dataset sql read through the DuckDB parse tree. Matched case-insensitively, as DuckDB binds every consumer. Read-only: nothing is refused or rewritten. Answers {schema, path, column, mapped, total, consumers:[{kind, name, key, value}], notAnalysed:[{kind, name, key}]} - notAnalysed names the SQL texts the census could not read or attribute, which may read the column too. get.summary: Arrivals of an Add data Dataset
get.description: The files the Dataset's import Pipeline took (uploads or inbox drops), newest 200 first, with times, rows read and rejected, the period covered and upload details; a Dataset no import made answers no arrivals and a reason. No capability gate; the Dataset's view access applies. 503 when read-only; 404 for an unknown or shared-away Dataset; 400 for an id the store refuses.

put.summary: Change which Entity Type one Dataset column holds
put.description: LA-ONBOARD-1 UC-07. canAuthorWorkbench. Body: at most one of {entityType: '<id>' | null} or {classification: '<X>' | null}, and/or (LA-COLUMN-ROLES-1) role (entity|temporal|measure|dimension|detail), unit (a measure's) and carried (false keeps a Time, Measure or Category column off the links and their index; true or null carries it again); null clears each, at least one key. The Dataset is re-assessed on the next Entity profile read. Gates: 401/403; 503 no write root; 404 unknown Dataset or one the caller cannot see; 403 view-only; 409 an approval policy holds Datasets; 422 unknown column or Entity Type, or the entry then breaks the Dataset rules. Answers {dataset, column, classification, entityType?, columns}.

post.summary: Compact an import Dataset now
post.description: Merges the Dataset's arrival files into one, ordered by arrival, whatever the file count, and returns the storage state with the compaction result. Gated on canUploadData. 503 when read-only or the Space has no data directory; 403 when Add data is off; 404 for an unknown Dataset; 409 when it is not an Add data import or is being imported or deleted.

get.summary: Inbox and feed of an import Dataset
get.description: The Dataset's inbox path, the files waiting there (up to 50 named) and which were already imported, and its feed (uploads, folder or sftp) with the folder-watch state. Gated on canUploadData. 503 when read-only or the Space has no data directory; 403 when Add data is off; 404 for an unknown Dataset; 409 when it is not an Add data import.

put.description: Body {kind: folder|sftp, connection?, every?, readyMarker?}: rewrites the import's Pipeline to a scheduled poll (every defaults to 15m, 1m to 1d) with a stability gate and duplicate skipping, and returns indexJob for the client to save. Standard and up. Gated on canUploadData. 503 on Basic or when read-only; 403 when Add data is off; 404; 409 when not an import, busy or under an approval policy; 422 for bad fields.

delete.summary: Return an import Dataset to manual uploads
delete.description: Rewrites the import's Pipeline back to manual uploads, in every edition, and returns the feed read. Gated on canUploadData. 503 when read-only or the Space has no data directory; 403 when Add data is off; 404 for an unknown Dataset; 409 when it is not an Add data import, is being imported or deleted, or an approval policy covers Pipelines; 422 when the rewritten Pipeline is refused.

post.summary: Add a file to an imported Dataset and run it
post.description: LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-2, DT-5. Raw file body, ?name=, ?mode=replace (default: the Dataset becomes this file's rows; the old data is restored if the run fails) or append (stream imports only), or period (replace the days it covers; needs a When column). ?newColumns=keep (default) keeps a later file's new columns as details of the Dataset (LA-ARRIVAL-NEW-COLUMNS-1: the schema and the Dataset's columns grow; the answer names them in keptColumns) or leave (left out, named in newColumns with newColumnsReason). The file must be the import's format and carry the columns it reads. Lands the file, runs the import Pipeline, then the in-run link index and Expectations (DT-16); answers the run summary with rowsBefore, rowsAfter, rowsChanged and replaced, or 202 above import.inline_max_bytes. Gates in order: capability (canUploadData) 401/403; 503 no write root; 403 when the Space's data.self_import is off (GET /settings/data); 404 unknown Dataset or one the caller cannot see; 403 view-only; 409 not an import Dataset, or an import of it is in flight; 422 name, mode, format or columns; 413 over import.max_bytes.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: replace (default) or append

default.description: Envelope-wrapped run summary (200) or followed-run record (202).

get.summary: Row filter of an import Dataset
get.description: The conditions the import keeps rows by (filter) and the columns a condition may name, with their types. Gated on canUploadData. 503 when read-only or the Space has no data directory; 403 when Add data is off; 404 for an unknown Dataset; 409 when it is not an Add data import or its schema is gone.

put.summary: Edit an import Dataset's row filter
put.description: Body {filter: [{column, op, value | min | max, matchCase?}]} ([] or null keeps every row): rewrites the import Pipeline's where and the entry's importFilter together, for files added from now on. Gated on canUploadData. 503 when read-only; 403 when Add data is off; 404 for an unknown Dataset; 409 when not an import, busy or under an approval policy; 422 for a missing filter or a refused condition.

put.summary: Say what one row of a Dataset is (its record type)
put.description: ENTITY-TYPE-CATALOG-1 P2. canAuthorWorkbench. Body {recordType: '<id>' | null}: a record type of the Space's Industry packs (GET /inv/entity-types answers recordTypes), or null to clear it. It only orders the 'what does this column hold' choices: the record type's likely Entity Types first. Gates: 401/403; 503 no write root; 404 unknown Dataset or one the caller cannot see; 403 view-only; 409 an approval policy holds Datasets; 422 recordType missing, not a string or null, or not a record type of this Space. Answers {dataset, recordType}.

post.summary: Run now: run an imported Dataset's Pipeline over what waits in its inbox
post.description: LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-2, DT-5/DT-16. Runs the import Pipeline once, then builds the link index and evaluates its Expectations inside the same run; answers the run summary. Gates in order: capability (canUploadData) 401/403; 503 no write root; 403 when the Space's data.self_import is off (GET /settings/data); 404 unknown Dataset or one the caller cannot see; 403 view-only; 409 not an import Dataset, or an import of it is in flight.

get.summary: Storage state of an import Dataset
get.description: The Dataset's Parquet file count and bytes, the compaction threshold, the last compaction, compacted and removed arrivals, and its retention policy. Gated on canUploadData. 503 when read-only or the Space has no data directory; 403 when Add data is off; 404 for an unknown Dataset; 409 when it is not an Add data import.

put.description: Body {retention: {days: N} | {arrivals: N} | null}, N from 1 to 100000, applied at the next compaction; Standard and up. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench. 503 when read-only, without a data directory or on an edition without retention; 403 when Add data is off; 404 for an unknown Dataset; 409 when not an import or an approval policy covers Datasets; 422 for a bad retention.

Body {watch: true|false}: toggles polling of the Dataset's inbox every 30 s, importing once every waiting file has settled; answers the feed read. put.description: LA-GROW-EXCLUDE-1 phase 4. Body {ownerKind?: admin|analyst, autoApply?: boolean, visibility?: open|restricted, reason}: at least one attribute; a key left out keeps its value. Gated on canManageExclusionCategories. Only a list of purpose exclusion carries these attributes (422 otherwise); autoApply true and visibility restricted belong to an ownerKind admin list only (422 on an analyst one). Appends one list.attributes-changed fact naming only the keys that change; nothing to change answers changed 0 and writes nothing. Held as a Pending Change under an approval policy for kind entity-list. Answers the list as GET /entity-lists/{id} does, plus changed.

get.description: Returns the Incident's Briefs, newest first, with their citations filtered to what the caller can see. Gated on canWorkIncidents. 404 when the Incident is absent or not visible; 422 when the object is not an Incident; 503 when operational objects are not installed.

Gated on canWorkIncidents. 422 for an unknown key, a non-object propose or an object that is not an Incident; 404 when the Incident is absent or not visible; 503 when read-only or operational objects are not installed.

post.description: Body {key, entityType?, investigationId?, status?: open|closed|all, limit?: 1..200} -> {entityType, resolved, reason?, objects:[{kind, id, title, status, severity?, createdAt, matchedOn, via?}], total, truncated, masking:{mode, masked}}. The key (alias, Investigation pseudonym or raw id) is resolved server-side with the /inv/reference-rows rules: an alias only for an Entity Type the masking covers; under that masking a raw key names nothing (resolved=false, no oracle). The Entity Type is, for an alias key, entityType when given (one of the Space's Entity Types in force, else 422; ignored for a raw key), else the Investigation's endpoint type, else msisdn. Same matching and visibility as GET /objects/by-entity; no key is echoed and titles are re-masked. Gates: 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE on Basic (Case history is Standard and up, the investigations edition feature; answered at dispatch), 503 write root, 503 Case management not installed, 422 body, 404/403 Investigation, 422 unsearchable key.

get.summary: What is in one Dataset: entities, busiest, kinds of link, period, Measure totals
get.description: LA-BASIC-DISCOVER-1 (Basic and up). {dataset, computedAt, cached, rows, roles {from, to, kind, time}, entityTypes {items [{type, label, columns, distinct, approximate, masked}]}, period {column, from, to, days}, linkKinds {column, items [{kind, links}], truncated}, busiest {from [{entity, links, counterparts}], to [...], source}, measures {items [{column, unit, rows, sum, median}]}, masking}. Every section carries assessed and reason: a role the Dataset does not map, or a read that failed or ran past the Space's statement timeout, is not assessed - never a zero. Distinct entities and medians are approximate. The busiest (top 10 per end, by distinct counterparts) come from a current link index when one exists, else from the Dataset. Busiest entity ids are exploration aliases when the Space masks them. Cached until the Dataset's input files change. Gated by the geoLink feature, a write root and R3 view access to the Dataset. Audited as LINK_DATASET_DISCOVERED (no entity id).

get.summary: List the Files recorded towards a Dataset, with each File's index state
get.description: LA-DATA-TRUST-1 S1. Query: limit (default 100, max 1000), offset, name (case-insensitive substring). One row per File from the Consignment audit trail (status ledger joined to lineage and batches of every Pipeline whose batches wrote the Dataset's stores; the problem Files of such a Pipeline are included): {name, day (event day of its output partition, null when it wrote none), rows (0 for a File read with no rows, distinct from no File), errorRows (null = not measured), ingestedAt (the Consignment commit time as a UTC ISO instant, NOT arrival time), outcome (SUCCESS | PARTIAL | QUARANTINED | FAILED, or the ledger's own word such as PARKED), collector, pipeline, consignmentId, indexState (INDEXED | WAITING | UNKNOWN | NO_INDEX | null when the File wrote no partition file), indexVersion (the live version, when INDEXED)}, newest ingested-at first. Also {assessed, total (after the name filter), offset, limit, days [{day, files, rows}], summary {files, rows, latestIngestedAt, indexed, waiting, unknown, problem} over ALL Files, index {present, version, builtAt, inputsRecorded}, readAt, note}. Index state is matched from the live IndexManifest input files (never guessed from timestamps): UNKNOWN when the manifest recorded no list (past 5000 files or an older build) or its list shares nothing with any File. assessed:false (items empty) when no audit trail attributes the Dataset - never read it as no Files. Gated by the geoLink feature, a write root, and R3 view access to the Dataset (unknown and not-viewable are the same 404). No capability.

404.description: No such Dataset, or not viewable by the caller (the same answer).

422.description: A limit or offset out of range.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

post.description: LA-QUERY-BUILDER-1 (Basic and up). Body {query {by (from|to), rank (links|counterparts|sum), sumColumn?, from?, to?, kinds?, timeColumn?, after?, before?, measureColumn?, measureMin?, measureMax?, min?, top?}}. Declarative, never free SQL: any other key is refused; timeColumn must be a Time column of the Dataset, sumColumn and measureColumn a Measure (GET /inv/presets lists them); after / before are a day or an ISO instant, a half-open window; every value is bound. Answer {dataset, query, columns [{id, label, entity}], rows, count, truncated, masking}, like a preset run. Entity columns are exploration aliases when the Space masks; from / to may be such an alias. At most top rows (500, and the Space's entity fence), under the Space's statement timeout. Read-shaped: persists nothing. Audited as LINK_QUERY_RUN. A Space preset saved from the builder is a preset-query component {label, description, query}, run through this route.

post.summary: Validate an Open in Inspecto LA link's parameters
post.description: LA-EDITIONS-1 section 4 (roadmap I5). The SPA's /open page sends the link's parameters in the BODY: {entity?: "<type>:<key>", investigation?: id, window?: {from?, to?}, reveal?: boolean}. For a type masked under the Space's maskingMode the key must be the exploration alias (masked:<16 hex>): a raw value is refused 422 without being repeated (get the alias from POST /inv/entities/{type}/resolve). Answers {entity?: {type, key (alias or normalised value), masked, revealed?}, investigation?: {id, title}, window?}. reveal:true on a masked entity returns its raw value only to a holder of canRevealLinkEntities (403 otherwise), audited as LINK_ENTITY_REVEALED naming the alias. Reads no Dataset and persists nothing; no capability for the read itself.

post.description: la-entity-profile-plan section 4.5 (operator 2026-10-15: a raw identifier never travels in a URL). Body {key: a raw value or an exploration alias}. Answers {type, key, masked}: for a type masked under the Space's maskingMode the exploration alias (masked:<16 hex>) of the normalised key, else the normalised value. Reads no Dataset and persists nothing. Gated by the geoLink feature and a write root; no capability. Rate-limited like the Entity profile. Audited as LINK_ENTITY_KEY_RESOLVED (the key is never recorded).

post.description: LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-9. Body {prefix?: a raw prefix (empty or absent = every value), dataset?: one Dataset id, limit?: 1..20 (default 8), reveal?: true to list a masked type's raw values (needs canRevealLinkEntities)}. Reads only the type's link-end columns (a source or target of a mapping the Space knows: a Dataset's defaultLinkMapping, a saved view or an index) on Datasets the caller may view, optionally one Dataset's. Answers {type, masked, revealed, datasets, items [{value, links (rows naming it in a link column), firstSeen, lastSeen}], distinct (Entities matching), truncated, assessed, reason}, busiest first. A type masked under the Space's maskingMode lists no value and is counted only for an empty prefix, unless the caller sends reveal: true and holds canRevealLinkEntities (LA-ONBOARD-DEFECTS-1; revealed: true, audited). The prefix travels in the body only. Gated by the geoLink feature and a write root; no capability unless reveal is asked. Rate-limited like the Entity profile. Audited as LINK_ENTITY_SUGGESTED (the prefix and values are never recorded).

get.description: la-entity-profile-plan section 4.5. For a type masked under the Space's maskingMode the key is the exploration alias (masked:<16 hex>) only - a raw value is refused 422, pointing at POST /inv/entities/{type}/resolve, so a raw identifier never travels in a URL; for an unmasked type the value itself. get.summary: List the Entity Types in force with their bindings and cached headline
get.description: la-entity-profile-plan section 4.5. {items: [{id, label, normaliser, masked, classifications, family?, definition?, example?, shape?, bindings: [{dataset, column, role}], headline: {distinct, approximate, rows, dataAsOf, computedAt, assessed, reason}}], families: [{id, label, definition}], recordTypes: [{id, label, definition, likelyTypes}]}. recordTypes are what one row of a Dataset can be, from the Space's Industry packs (ENTITY-TYPE-CATALOG-1 P2; empty with no pack), each with the Entity Type ids such a record usually holds. family is one of the closed families (ENTITY-TYPE-CATALOG-1: party, organisation, account, identifier, device, place, document), listed in families in picker order; family, definition and example are reader guidance, and shape is the value shape from the closed vocabulary (free, e164, digits(n|a-b), luhn(n|a-b), iban, email, uuid), each absent when nothing states it. A binding is every Dataset column whose classification the type claims; role is source / target when the column is a link end of a saved Link Analysis view or a published index mapping, else attribute. The headline is the last computed type profile (cached, never a query on this request): assessed:false with reason 'not computed yet' until the type's profile has been read once. get.summary: Read the Entity Type profile: aggregates over every column bound to the type
get.description: la-entity-profile-plan section 4.5. Query: sections (comma list of bindings, volume, shapes, time, lineage, links, relationships, measures; all when absent), from / to (a window over the measures section only, echoed as window {from, to}). {entityType, computedAt, cached, truncated, masking {mode, masked}} plus each requested section: measures [{dataset, column, measure, unit, rows, sum, min, max, distribution {entities, p50, p90, max, sampled, every, sampleEntities, approximate (when sampled), truncated, assessed, reason}, assessed, reason}] (LA-COLUMN-ROLES-2 D-1: one row per binding x Measure of its Dataset over the rows where the bound column names an Entity, inside the window on the binding's time column - a binding with none is not assessed inside a window; a column holding an Entity Type is never a Measure; distribution = the per-Entity totals over at most entity_profile.measure_sample_entities Entities, above it a key-hash sample of 1 in every), bindings [{dataset, column, role, timeColumn, rows, nonNull, fillRate, distinct, approximate, failNormaliser, assessed, reason}], volume {distinct, approximate, rows, sentinels [{dataset, column, kind: builtin|dominant, value (null for dominant), rows, share}], assessed, reason}, shapes {length [{length, rows}], prefix [{prefix, rows}], prefixLength (e164 3, else 0), charClass {digits, letters, mixed}, sampled, assessed, reason}, time {earliest, latest, perDay [{day, rows, distinct}], missingDays, dataAsOf [{dataset, dataAsOf}], assessed, reason}, lineage [{dataset, pipelines, collectors, files, rows, latestIngestedAt, waitingForIndex, problemFiles, assessed, reason}], links {from (dataset; index once the manifest carries link statistics), kinds [{kind, edges}], degree {p50, p90, p99, max}, hubThreshold, hubs, singleLink, assessed, reason}, relationships [{otherType, dataset, oneToOneShare, maxPerEntity, threshold, entitiesAtOrAboveThreshold, assessed, reason}]. Aggregates only: never a raw identifier (a dominant value is reported without its value; hubs are counted, not named). Distinct counts are over the normalised Entity key and approximate. A section that could not be read says assessed:false with the reason; a read cut by an entity_profile.* limit says truncated:true. Cached by the bound Datasets' input-file fingerprint (a new File invalidates it). Gated like POST /inv/projection: geoLink, a write root, R3 view access per Dataset. Audited as LINK_ENTITY_TYPE_PROFILED.

Answers {lists: [{id, title, entityType, ownerKind, autoApply, visibility, size}]}: every live (not retired) Entity List of purpose exclusion, category (ownerKind admin) lists first, then by title. Never members: a restricted list shows its size only.

post.summary: Unsaved Investigation preview: the Working Set its seed / expand / exclude steps would build (stores nothing)
post.description: LA-UNSAVED-INVESTIGATION-1. Body = the binding a create takes (dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, linkKindCol?, timeCol?, timeColZone?, eventsCol?, entityType? / sourceType? / targetType?) and steps[], the seed / expand / exclude bodies the step route would append, in order (1 to 4 seeds and expands plus at most 32 excludes: the Studio sends the Working Set as one seed, the unsaved Clean up excludes with their reasons and the next degree, never the history); an exclude (LA-INVESTIGATE-UX-2) drops its entities and keeps them out of every later expand, as on a saved Investigation (a merged exclude is 422: no resolve is in force); the expands read at most investigation.expand_budget_max rows in total (else 422). Each step is validated, read and evaluated by the same code as an append (bindings, frontier, four-eyes, the expand read with its budget, fan-out, hub threshold, direction, window and link kinds), so the Working Set equals what those steps record once saved. An expand above the four-eyes thresholds is not read: the walk stops with needsApproval. On a masked Space ids are taken ONLY as aliases its reads served (a raw value is 422, so guesses cannot be matched in bulk) and answered as aliases; each expand read is audited (LINK_EXPANDED) as the explorer's neighbours read is. Read-shaped and ungated like the explorer's neighbours reads; expensive rate class. Gates: write root 503, bad body or step 422, unknown or not-viewable Dataset 404, unknown column or bad zone 422. 503 on Basic.

items.description: A seed, expand or exclude op body, as POST /inv/investigations/{id}/ops takes it.

200.description: Envelope data: workingSet (entities, links, excluded with step and reason; no hash), steps[] ({step, op, needsApproval, admitted[]} or {step, needsApproval: true, exceeded[]}) and masked.

404.description: Unknown or not-viewable Dataset.

422.description: A bad body, step, column or zone.

503.description: No write root, or Basic (no Investigations).

post.summary: Third-party integration (inbound): open a seeded Investigation for an external record
post.description: LA-EDITIONS-1 section 4, phase 5. A fraud product or case manager hands over its own record and the entities it is about. Body {reference: {system, type? (default alert), id, url?, label?}, entities: ["<type>:<key>" ...], purpose, title?, window?: {from?, to?, ...}, binding?: {dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, linkKindCol?, timeCol?, timeColZone?, eventsCol?}}. Each entity is typed by an Entity Type in force; its key is a raw value (sent in the body) or an exploration alias, normalised by the type's normaliser. Without a binding, the first saved Link Analysis view or published index that links a column of EVERY Entity Type the call names is used (its kind and time columns come along); when no single mapping covers all the named types the call is refused 422 naming them, so name one type per call or send a binding. BEHAVIOUR CHANGE for integrators: a call naming several types used to bind through the first entity's type only and seed the rest unbound; it is now refused 422 unless one mapping covers them all or a binding is sent (an explicit binding is never second-guessed). Composes the existing writes: POST /inv/investigations (purpose, R3 Dataset gate), one seed op per Entity Type, an optional window op, and an external reference (trusted:false). Idempotent on (reference.system, reference.id): the Investigation id is derived from them (ext-<32 hex>), so a repeat - or a racing duplicate on any node - answers the SAME Investigation with created:false and adds nothing. Answers {investigationId, created, seeded, reference, link: "/open?investigation=<id>" (the la-app route; the console mounts it at /studio/open), note}. Gated on canOpenInboundInvestigation (OIDC-CC-INTEGRATION-ROLE-1; seed role integration). A machine (client-credentials) caller is admitted only in a Space whose roles.toon names its client in identity.machineClients (403 elsewhere) and keeps only allowlisted capabilities; it reads the Investigations it leads. Rate-limited with the expensive Link Analysis class (429: retry, it is idempotent).

type.description: What the record is in that system (default alert).

id.description: The record's id in that system.

url.description: An absolute http(s) URL to the record; never fetched.

window.description: An Investigation window {from?, to?, ...}; needs a time column.

binding.description: The Dataset and link columns, when the Space's views and indexes do not say.

404.description: The binding's Dataset is unknown or not viewable by the caller.

409.description: This external reference already opened an Investigation the caller cannot change.

422.description: A malformed reference, entity, window or binding; an unknown Entity Type; no view or index links the entity's type; no purpose.

503.description: No write root.

get.description: LA-EDITIONS-1 phase 6. canAdminister. Answers {handoffConfigured, webhooksConfigured, installed, settings, events, placeholders, note}. settings is la-integration.json as stored: handoff {connection, system, authHeader?, template?, caseIdPointer, caseUrlPointer?}, webhooks {connection, signingSecret (a ${...} reference), events}, retry {count, backoff, initialDelayMillis, maxDelayMillis}. It never holds a secret.

put.summary: Replace the Space's third-party integration settings
put.description: LA-EDITIONS-1 phase 6. canAdminister. Gates: 403 -> write root 503 -> 422 (unknown key, a connection or system name that is not a safe name, an authHeader the transport or the signature sets, a template placeholder outside the published list, a template over 64 KiB, a signingSecret that is not a ${...} reference, an unknown event, a retry value out of range) -> atomic write. Audited as LINK_INTEGRATION_CHANGED with before/after.

422.description: Invalid settings; nothing was written.

503.description: No write root.

delete.description: Delete an Investigation with its sealed log, Working Sets, Drafts, members, references, alert-rule bindings, pending records, Case link and embed grants (LA-INVESTIGATION-DELETE-1); it cannot be undone. Gated on canManageIncidents and a lead of the Investigation (a read-only Case member or a stranger reads 404). 409 CONFLICT while the Investigation is linked to an open Case or has a pending four-eyes approval. An audit event LINK_INVESTIGATION_DELETED (actor, time, id, title, steps and Drafts removed) is written first. Answers {id, deleted, steps, drafts}. 503 on a store backend that cannot delete (Postgres).

patch.description: Rename an Investigation and/or restate its purpose (LA-INVESTIGATION-RENAME-1). Body {title?, purpose?}: at least one; title non-blank and at most 200 chars; purpose non-blank and within the Space's input.purpose_length. The sealed header is never rewritten: the edit is a details record beside it, shown by every read (log header, list, embed) while an issued Dossier still verifies. Gated on canManageIncidents and a lead of the Investigation (a non-lead member 403; a stranger or an unknown id 404). An edit writes only the fields it was given, in one read-modify-write per Investigation, so two edits at once never undo each other (LA-INVESTIGATION-EDIT-HARDENING-1); an edit racing a delete answers 404. An unreadable details record is ignored with a warning (the sealed values show) and the next edit replaces it. An audit event LINK_INVESTIGATION_EDITED records the fields changed with their values before and after, masked per the Space's maskingMode. Answers {id, title, purpose, updatedBy, updatedAt}, masked per the Space's maskingMode.

403.description: No canManageIncidents, or a member who is not a lead.

404.description: No such Investigation, not readable by the caller, or deleted under the edit.

422.description: Neither field given, a blank or over-long title, or a blank or over-long purpose.

503.description: No write root, or Investigations are not available in this edition (Basic).

get.summary: List the read-only embed links of an Investigation
get.description: LA-EMBED-VIEW-1. Read-shaped: any reader of the Investigation. {investigationId, enabled, grants[], max}; each grant {grantId, label, issuedBy, issuedAt, expiresAt, status (active|expired|revoked), revokedAt?, revokedBy?, revokedReason?, lastViewAt?, viewCount}. Never a token or a token hash. Expired grants lose their hash here (the row stays).

404.description: No such Investigation, or not readable by the caller (the same answer).

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: Mint a read-only embed link to an Investigation
post.description: LA-EMBED-VIEW-1 (operator decisions 2026-10-12). Body {ttl_hours?, label?, scope?, masking_mode?}: scope is working_set | with_notes | full (default full; the Working Set is always shown), masking_mode is none | typed | all and never looser than the Space's (422), so a link can only be stricter. Gated on canShareInvestigation (no four-eyes) and on the caller being a LEAD of the Investigation; the Advanced ABAC action `embed` can forbid it. 503 unless -Dla.embed.enabled=true. ttl_hours defaults to the Space embed.default_ttl_hours (72) and is refused with 422 above embed.max_ttl_hours (default 720 = 30 days; a Space may raise it up to 8760 = 365 days), never clamped. A frame allowlist is refused (422): links are link-only. 422 also when the Investigation reads data of a classification in the Space embed.refuse_classifications. Answers {grantId, investigationId, token, url, expiresAt, label, maskingMode, note}: the token is shown ONCE and only its SHA-256 is stored. Minting writes a sidecar, never an op-log entry: the Dossier root and the op-log hash do not move. At most 20 live links per Investigation (409).

403.description: The caller lacks canShareInvestigation, is not a lead of the Investigation, or an access policy denies the action embed.

404.description: No such Investigation, or not visible to the caller (the same answer).

409.description: The Investigation already holds 20 live links.

422.description: ttl_hours outside 1..the Space maximum, an unknown field (frame_ancestors included: framing is a Space setting, not a per-link one), a bad scope, a masking_mode looser than the Space's, a bad label, or a refused classification.

503.description: Embed links are disabled (-Dla.embed.enabled) or there is no write root.

post.summary: Revoke one embed link of an Investigation
post.description: LA-EMBED-VIEW-1. Gated on canShareInvestigation and on the caller being a LEAD of the Investigation. Immediate: the link answers the uniform 404 from the next request on; its token hash is dropped and the row stays. Idempotent. Links also revoke automatically when their minter loses their lead role, the Investigation's linked Case closes, or the Space's masking is loosened.

403.description: The caller lacks canShareInvestigation or is not a lead.

404.description: No such Investigation or link.

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: Grow preview: dry-run an expand and answer what it would add (appends nothing)
post.description: LA-GROW-EXCLUDE-1 GE-3. Body = exactly the expand op body the Investigation would append (op optional, expand only): the same validation, budget, fan-out, hub threshold, direction, window, link kinds and index-or-flat read, evaluated against the Working Set, so the counts equal the delta of that expand appended right after on the same data. Seals nothing, appends nothing, emits no event. A body above the four-eyes thresholds is not read: it answers needsApproval: true with null counts and exceeded[]. Gated as the append: canManageIncidents, a lead of the Investigation (others 404 / a non-lead member 403). 503 on Basic.

addsLinks.description: Links the step would add (null when needsApproval).
